dag pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i chos kyi sku mngon du byed pa de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa/ sprul pa'i sku sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don byed pa lha so so'i dag pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ zung 'jug gi bde ba chen po brnyes pa rang rig pa'i dag pa/ 'bras bu'i rgyud kyi dag pa gsum mo// nges par dngos po thams cad kyi nas/ 'di ltar 'gro ba sangs rgyas 'gyur gyi bar gsungs so// de ltar rgyu dang lam dang*/ 'bras bu dag pa gsum gyi rang bzhin yin pas kyang grol bar 'thad la/ gnyis pa rigs dang rigs kyi bdag po yin pa'i phyir/ grol bar 'thad pa ni/ ma dag pa 'khor ba'i sems can/ dag pa sangs rgyas kyi rgyu'am rigs yin zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyang 'bras bu'am rigs bdag yin la/ khyad par du sems can gyi lus ngag yid gsum las/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs dang*/ phung po lnga las rigs lnga dang*/ nyon mongs pa lnga las ye shes lnga 'byung ste/ rigs dang 'byung ba lnga rnams dang nas/ mngon par brjod par bya zhes gsungs pas/ sems can dang sangs rgyas rigs dang*/ rigs kyi bdag po yin pa'i phyir cis kyang grol bar 'thad do// gsum pa thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i phyir grol bar 'thad pa ni/ dper na khyi smyon gyi mche ba la sogs pa g.yo ba'i dug gis zin pa'i gnyen por/ btsan dug la sogs pa brten pa'i dug 'gro ba ltar/ tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pa'i gnyen por/ lam gyi rnam par rtog pa bsgom pa rigs 'dra gnyen por che ba ste/ dug gi dum bu gang nyid nas/ 'bigs par byed kyi bar gsungs so// yang snod bcud kyi srid pa la zhen pa'i gnyen por gzhal yas khang dang lha'i srid pa bsgom pa bzlog pa gnyen por che ba ste/ ji ltar rlung gis zin pa nas/ snun par byed kyi bar gsungs/ yang mgo gcig tu zhen pa'i rnam par rtog pa sbyang pa'i don du/ zhal brgyad bsgom pa la sogs pa sbams pa gnyen por che ba ste/

ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs pa nas/ sbyang bar bya zhes gsungs/ yang tha mal gyi 'dod chags kyi gnyen por dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lam bsgom pa bsnan pa gnyen por che ba ste/ ji ltar 'tshed pa nas/ gdung bar bya zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang lta ba rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas/ dngos po dang mtshan mas mi 'ching zhing grol bar 'gyur ba dang*/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i thabs dang ldan pas 'dod yon gyi bde ba la longs spyod pas lam du 'gyur ba dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi thabs dang ldan pas/ nyon mongs pa dang rtog pa thams cad lam du 'gyur bas/ mi 'ching zhing grol ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin te/ dngos po nyid kyis grol bar nas/ de ltar he ru ka bsgom bya// zhes gsungs/ des grol ba'i rgyu mtshan bshad de/ de dag gis rim pa gnyis kyi spyi'i mngon par rtogs pa bstan to// //mngon par rtogs pa lam gyi sngon du 'gro ba/ smin par byed pa dbang dang 'brel/ de la gzhan don slob ma rjes su gzung ba/ sngon du bsnyen pa/ sa'i cho ga sta gon/ dkyil 'khor bri zhing rgyan dgram pa/ sgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang bskur ba/ mjug gi cho ga dang brgyad yod/ de la thog mar slob ma rjes su gzung ba ni/ slob ma dad pa dang snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa/ bla ma dang gsang sngags kyi lam la brten nas dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pa gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar kha yar bas/ bla ma la maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gyis// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin skyobs// zhes gsol ba 'debs pa la rjes su 'dzin par khas blangs nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa la sogs pa sngon du 'gro ba'i chos la slob du gzhug go /gnyis pa bsnyen pa la/ rab mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa/ lhas dngos sam rmi lam du gnang ba byin pa'am/ 'bring dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba drug gam/

tha ma grangs kyi bsnyen pa gtso bo la 'bum phrag gcig dang*/ 'khor rnams la khri phrag gcig bzla'o// sa'i cho ga la lnga las/ brtag pa ni/ 'tshe ba med cing yo byad phun sum tshogs la/ kha dog dang*/ dbyibs dang*/ mtshan ma bzang ba'i sa btsal lo// bslang ba ni/ mngon pa las bslang ba/ sa'i bdag po la dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi re zhig bslang ba'am/ g.yar ba yin/ mi mngon pa las bslang ba ni/ sa'i lha mo dang gzhi bdag la slong ba yin te/ brtag pa gnyis pa las/ gong gi a sogs sngags nyid kyis// de la gtor ma rnam par sbyin zhes gsungs/ sbyang ba la gnyis/ las dang bya bas skyon sbyang bas sa'i zug rngu bsal ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bgegs sbyang ba/ rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ khro bo bcu'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ khro bo bcu spros nas bgegs tshar gcod pa'o// bsrung ba ni slar bgegs mi 'jug pa'i phyir srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa yin/ gzung ba ni shar du g.yas brkyang la sogs pa'i stang stabs dang*/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas sems can gyi don bya'o snyam du blos yongs su 'dzin pa'o// bzhi pa sta gon la/ sa'i lha mo sta gon/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon du gnas pa dang bzhi yin/ lnga pa bri zhing rgyan dgram pa la/ thig gis bri ba/ tshon gyis bri ba/ mtshan ma dgod pa/ rgyan dgram pa ste bzhi yin/ drug pa sgrub cing mchod pa la/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bdun bsres kyi sgo nas bsgrubs nas/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byas te byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ phyi nang yid las byung bas mchod pa dang bstod pa gnyis yin/ bdun pa 'jug cing dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon rang nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis yin no// slob ma gzhug pa la/ yol ba'i phyir gzhug pa dang*/ nang du 'jug pa gnyis/ dbang bskur ba la/ rdo rje gur las/ bum pa'i dbang gis dang po ste/

gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang yin no// gsum pa shes rab ye shes te// bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no// zhes gsungs pas/ dbang rnam pa bzhi bskur ba yin no// brgyad pa mjug gi cho ga la/ bla ma la gtang rag dbul ba/ dkyil 'khor la mchod cing bstod nas dngos grub blang ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba/ bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol ba/ rdul tshon bsdus nas chu bor dor ba/ dga' ston la longs spyod pa/ slob ma la dam tshig dang bslab bya bstan pa ste bdun yod do// //mngon par rtogs pa gtso bor thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa dang 'brel pa las/ 'dir rab tu gnas pa dang sbyin sreg ston/ de la rab gnas la/ rab tu gnas pa dngos/ de'i ming gi rab dbye/ rab tu gnas pa'i phan yon dang gsum las/ dang po rab gnas dngos la/ gang la rab tu gnas par bya ba'i rten yongs su dag pa bzang po/ gang du rab tu gnas par byed pa'i gnas yongs su dag pa bzang po/ gang dag gis rab tu gnas par byed pa'i yo byad yongs su dag pa bzang po/ ji ltar rab tu gnas par byed pa'i cho ga ste/ yongs su dag pa bzang po drug las de la dang po rten ni/ rten mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing*/ bzo'i bya ba rdzogs pa ste/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ tshad kyis tshad la phab cing shis// de 'drar rab tu gnas byar bsngags// zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa slob dpon ni/ dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa/ lha'i rnal 'byor la brten pa/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pa/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga mthong ba cig dgos te/ brtag gnyis las/ rang 'dod lha mnyam pha rol son// zhes gsungs/ gsum pa dus ni/ gza' dang*/ skar ma dang*/ sbyor ba bzang po 'dzom pa'i yar gyi ngo la bya'o// bzang na mar gyi ngo la'ang nyes pa med de/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ dbang bskur dang ni rab gnas dag /yar gyi ngo la brtag par bya// gza' dang skar ma 'dzom gyur na// mar gyi ngo la'ang nyes pa med// ces gsungs/

bzhi pa gnas ni/ 'tshe ba med cing yo byad phun sum tshogs la yid spro zhing bkra shis pa'i mtshan ma dang ldan pa'i gnas su bya/ lnga pa yo byad ni/ dkyil 'khor dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ rab gnas dang 'brel ba'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa 'dzom pas bya'o// drug pa cho ga la gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba la/ rten sbyang ba/ sku khrus gsol ba/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa/ mchod cing bstod pa/ nang par rab gnas byed par snyan gsan dbab pa/ ye shes pa mchod nas gshegs su gsol ba/ rten zhal dgab cing bsrung ba dang bdun yod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la'ang sbyang ba/ khrus bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa/ mchod bstod dang bzhi sta gon dang 'dra/ spyan dbye ba/ brten par bzhugs su gsol ba/ mnga' dbul rgyas par bya ba rnams dngos gzhi'i cho ga'o// rjes kyi bya ba la/ rten bzhugs sar spyan drang ba/ rten la srung ma bsgo ba/ rten yon bdag la gtad pa/ cho ga lhag chad kha bskang ba/ bla ma la yon dbul la/ smon lam gdab pa/ dga' ston bya ba ste bdun no// gnyis pa ming gi don ni/ sku gzugs la ye shes pa gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ rab tu gnas pa/ rten de sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir spyan dbye ba/ mchod pa thob cing byin gyis rlob pa mthu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir mnga' dbul ba zhes bya bar 'gyur ba'o// gsum pa phan yon ni/ rab tu gnas pa'i rten gcig la mchod pa byas pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod par 'gyur bas dge ba 'phel ba dang*/ dngos grub stsol bar 'gyur ba ste/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ skye bo rab tu dang ba yis// byed pa dge ba 'phel ba'i phyir// rab gnas bstan bcos las bshad pa// tha snyad tsam du byas pa yin// zhes gsungs so// //dngos grub myur du 'grub par byed pa'i thabs sbyin sreg la/ sbyin sreg ji ltar bya ba dang*/ de'i ming don/ de'i phan yon dang gsum du yod pa las/

dang po sbyin sreg dngos la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum yod pa'i/ sbyor ba la/ thab bud shing dang bcas pa/ me yam shing dang bcas pa/ mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas dang bcas pa/ bsham tshul dus dang bcas pa/ sgrub pa po'i khyad par dang lnga yod pa las/ dang po thab la drug yod pa'i/ dbyibs ni zhi ba la zlum po/ rgyas pa la gru bzhi/ dbang la zla gam/ drag po la gru gsum/ gnyis pa kha dog ni/ zhi ba la kha dog dkar po/ rgyas pa la ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ drag po la nag por bya/ gsum pa tshad ni/ zhi ba la rgyar khru gang*/ dpangs su khru byed/ rgyas pa la rgyar khru do/ dpangs su khru gang*/ drag po la rgyar sor nyi shu/ dpangs su de'i phyed/ dbang la zhi ba'i tshad dang mtshungs pa yin no// bzhi pa mu ran ni zhi ba la sor bzhi/ rgyas pa la sor brgyad/ dbang la sor bzhi/ drag po la sor gsum rnams/ rgyar bkyed pa ni kha khyer/ de'i tshad kyis dpangs su brtsig pa ni mu ran no// lnga pa mtshan ma ni/ mu ran la/ zhi ba la rdo rje kha zum pa/ rgyas pa la rin po che/ dbang la pad+ma/ drag po la rdo rje gdengs pa bkod nas/ dbus su mtshan ma dgod pa yin/ drug pa bud shing ni/ zhi ba la 'o ma can gyi rtse mo/ rgyas pa la 'bras bu can gyi rked pa/ dbang la me tog dmar po can gyi rtse mo/ drag po la tsher ma can gyi rtsa ba'i cha ste/ ring thung thab dang 'tsham par bgyed/ don gnyis pa me dang yam shing ni/ zhi ba la bram ze rgyun zhag gam/ shing bsrubs pa'i me/ yam shing sor mo'i sbom phra tsam sor bcu gnyis pa/ rgyas pa la rgyal rigs kyi khyim gyi me'am/ rin po che gtsubs pa'i yam shing mthe bo'i sbom phra tsam khru gang pa/ dbang la smad 'tshong ma'i khyim gyi me'am shing dmar po bsrubs pa'i me yam shing zhi ba dang 'dra/ drag po la gdol ba'i khyim gyi me'am/ ro bsregs pa'am/ rdo bsrubs pa'i me/ yam shing mthe'u chung gi sbom phra tsam pa khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i ring thung tsam du byed/

gsum pa mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas ni/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ yam shing dang mar la sogs pa ni thun mong gi bsreg rdzas yin la/ khyad par gyi bsreg rdzas ni/ zhi ba la til/ rgyas pa la zho las byas pa'i zas mchog dbang la ut+pa la'am/ me tog dmar po/ drag por la dug dang tsher ma dang liṅga la sogs pa dbul lo// bzhi pa bsham pa'i tshul ni/ 'jam po gsum la mchod rdzas g.yon/ bsreg rdzas g.yas la/ drag po la de las bzlog par bsham mo// dus ni zhi ba la srod kyi dus/ rgyas pa la snga dro/ dbang du bya ba la phyi dro/ drag po la nam phyed dam nyi ma phyed kyi dus su bya/ lnga pa sgrub pa po'i khyad par la lnga las/ bsam pa ni/ zhi ba la zhi zhing dul ba dang*/ rgyas pa la dga' zhing spro ba dang*/ dbang du bya ba la rjes su chags shing 'dun pa dang*/ drag po la khro zhing rngam pa'i bsam pas bya'o// gnyis pa kha lta phyogs ni/ zhi ba la shar/ rgyas pa la byang*/ dbang la nub/ drag po la lhor blta'o// gsum pa rgyan gos ni/ zhi ba la dkar po/ rgyas pa la ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ drag po la nag po'i rgyan dang*/ cha lugs dang ldan pas bya'o// bzhi pa 'dug stangs ni/ zhi ba la bram ze rig byed 'don pa ltar tsog pu/ rgyas pa la rgyal po rol pa/ dbang la pad+ma'i skyil krung*/ drag po la rkang pa g.yas pas g.yon pa mnan pa'i 'dug stangs kyis sbyin bsreg bya/ lnga pa dgang blugs ni/ las so so dang 'brel pa'am/ thun mong gi dgang blugs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ pus mo gnyis kyi khongs las mi 'da' bar bzung la zhu ba'i rdzas rnams 'bul ba yin no// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa/ mi btsal zhing bsgrub pa/ thab dang yo byad bsang ba/ thab dang yo byad mngon par 'du bya ba/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha bskyed nas mchod pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa la mchod pa dang bsreg rdzas kyi mchod pa ste drug yin no// gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la/

'das pa'i me lha gshegs su gsol nas/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha lhag mas mchod pa/ gtor ma phul nas gsol ba gdab pa/ bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol ba/ tsa ru'i bza' bas longs spyod pa/ smon lam gdab pa/ las kyi rjes bsdu ba ste/ 'di la'ang drug yin no// gnyis pa ming gi don ni/ me la bsreg blugs phul bas/ lha mnyes pa yin te/ saṃ pu ṭa las/ me ni lha yi kha yin te// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa phan yon ni/ lha mnyes na dngos grub myur du stsol ba ste/ sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshim// tshim nas dngos grub myur du stsol// gang zhig sngags kyi lhag chad dag /de ni sbyin sreg gis ni dgang*// zhes gsungs so// mngon par rtogs pa nye rgyu dang mtshams sbyor ba nye rgyu dang 'brel/ de la spyir phyag rgya bsten pa'i dus dang*/ bye brag tu nye rgyu nyid gtan la dbab pa gnyis yod pa las/ thog mar dus la dang po dbang dus/ bar du lam dus/ tha ma 'bras bu'i dus dang gsum yin/ de gsum ka la/ phyag rgya dngos su yod na myur du 'grub/ gsum ka la med na mi 'grub/ dang po gnyis su yod kyang*/ tha ma la med na mi 'grub la/ dang po gnyis su med kyang tha mar yod na 'grub pa yin no// de'ang rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ ā li kā li phyag rgya che// dngos grub thams cad ster bar byed// thabs dang shes rab ma gtogs par// mchog gi go 'phang 'thob mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa bye brag tu nye rgyu gtan la dbab pa la/ nye rgyu rang gi ngo bo gang gis tshe mngon du byed pa'i dus/ gang du mngon du byed pa'i gnas/ gang la brten pa'i rten/ ji ltar mngon du byed pa'i thabs/ de ltar mngon du byas pa'i 'bras bu dang drug yod pa las/ dang po nye rgyu rang gi ngo bo la gnyis las/ nye rgyu dngos ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i nye rgyu dkyil 'khor bzhi yin pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyis 'grub pa'i nye rgyu'ang dkyil 'khor bzhi yin la/

de'i yang gtso bo'i byang chub kyi sems brgyad dam drug gi bdag nyid can te/ thabs kyis rang byin rlabs bsgom pa'i zhu bde gnyis dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa'i zhu bde gnyis/ shes rab dang thabs gnyis kas bsgoms na des phye ba'i zhu bde gnyis gnyis te brgyad dam/ shes rab kyi rang byin brlab ma bsgoms kyang rung bas de ltar na drug go /de'ang saṃ pu ṭa las/ ā li bung ba zhes byar brjod// bung ba rdo rje 'jigs byed nyid// kā li me tog shes par bya// me tog rdo rje can gyi lus// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa rtsod pa spang ba ni/ sems la rtogs pa 'char ba lus la ltos par mi rigs so snyam na/ ji srid lus dang sems lhan cig tu gnas la de srid du tshogs pa gcig pa'i 'brel ba yod pas sems can gyi bde ba dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ gdung ba lus la brten nas 'byung ba ltar/ sangs rgyas pa'i tshe'ang*/ sems kyi rtogs pa lus la ltos pa yin te/ brtag gnyis las/ ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ ltos dang bcas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa dus la gnyis las/ bsgom pa'i dus ni/ sa brgyad pa man chad kyis bsgom pa yin la/ 'grub pa'i dus ni/ zhag bdun gyis 'grub pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ nyi ma gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur// nyi ma gnyis kyi cho ga dang*// nyi ma gsum gyi sbyor ba dang*// de bzhin du ni nyi ma bzhi// nyi ma lnga'i sbyor ba yis// 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// me tog la sogs mchod byas nas// bsam gtan gnas su 'dug pa dang*// phyag rgya lhan cig bzhugs nas ni// rdo rje sbyor ba yang dag brtsam// rdo rje nyi ma nub pa na// sbyor ba 'di ni yang dag brtsam// nyi ma shar ba'i dus su ni// 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// ces gsungs/ gsum pa gnas la gnyis las/ phyi'i gnas 'og min te/ 'ga' zhig gis gzugs khams kyi steng gi 'og min yin zer/

gzhan dag na re/ khams gsum las 'das pa rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho'i bzhugs gnas stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams yin gsungs kyang*/ yang dag par na sgrub pa po gong du sangs rgyas pa'i phyogs de nyid sangs rgyas de'i smon lam gyi dbang gis/ 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su snang ba yin no// gnyis pa nang gi gnas ni/ dbang gi gnas nyid yin te/ brtag gnyis las/ e'i cha byad nas/ rin chen za ma tog ces gsungs/ bzhi pa rten la bzhi las/ dang po nas goms pa ni/ dbang dus kyi rten la zer ba yin/ lung bstan pa ni/ yi dam mam rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan pa zer/ nus pas bkug pa ni/ rang gi mngon shes kyis brtags nas/ lha sogs sam/ mi mo mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug pa la byed pa yin/ mchog thob pa ni/ sa brgyad pa yan chad thob pa'i phyag rgya mo'o// mchog thob pa'i phyag rgya dang lhan cig nye rgyu bsgoms na dus gcig la 'tshang rgya bas na/ nye rgyus rgyud gnyis cig car grol zhes gsungs pa de la dgongs so// lnga pa mngon du byed pa'i thabs dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang 'dra ba yin no// drug pa 'bras bu 'grub pa'i tshul la/ phar phyin dang gsang sngags pa'i lugs gnyis las/ dang po ni sa bcu rdzogs pa'i mthar bar chad med pa'i lam gyis bdud btul nas// rnam grol gyi lam gyis 'tshang rgya bar 'dod do// gsang sngags kyi lugs la/ phyi'i mngon byang dang*/ nang gi mngon byang gnyis so// phyi'i ni de nyid bsdus pa ltar/ byang chub sems dpa' don grub mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhag pa/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pas bskul nas/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas sa bcu pa mchog tu gyur pa mngon byang dang po de nyid las yon tan gong du 'phel zhing*/ glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba zla ba gnyis par mthong ba mngon byang gnyis pa/

chos nyid kyi rtogs pa brtan pas/ chos can ma 'dres pa so sor mkhyen pa de mtshon byed kyi brdar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje bsgom pa mngon byang gsum pa/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad snying ga'i rdo rje la thim de dag dang dbyer med du gyur/ rang nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang tha dad med par mthong*/ rang bzhin gyi don 'grub pa bya ba grub pa/ de'i tshe sku dang ye shes ma lus pa mngon du byas pa ni lnga pa'o// gnyis pa nang gi 'grub tshul ni/ nye rgyu zhag bdun bsgoms pa'i bdun gyi tho rangs thabs kyi rigs bdag gi mthar thig le'i dwangs ma mngon du byas pa zla ba me long lta bu/ shes rab kyi rtsa mdzes pa'i spyi bor rak+ta'i dwangs ma mngon du byas pa nyi ma mnyam pa nyid/ rlung sems thams cad ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa so sor rtog pa/ rlung sems thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba nan tan/ rten dkyil 'khor bzhi ma lus pa dbu mar thim nas/ gtsug tor mchog grub pa'i tshe sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus pa gnas gyur te/ sku dang ye shes ma lus pa mngon du mdzad pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ mngon par byang chub pa lnga'i rim pas sangs rgyas nas 'khor ba ji srid du bzhugs pa'o// le'u gsum par// sdom pa zhes bya gang gis dang*// dam tshig gang gis gnas par bgyi// zhes pa'i skabs su mngon par rtogs pa gang dang 'brel na/ gnyis ka la dgos pa'i grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa dang 'brel/ de la dam tshig gi dbye ba/ rab tu dbye ba/ ji ltar bsrung ba'i tshul/ ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs/ bsrungs pa'i phan yon dang lnga las/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ ji ltar khas blangs pa dang*/ thob pa'i don mi 'da' bar bsrung ba'i sems pa rgyun chags can no// gnyis pa dbye ba la bzhi las/ dus kyis dbye na/ las dang po pa/ sems brtan pa thob pa/ brtan pa cher thob pa'i gnas skabs gsum/ dbang gis dbye na/

bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ dbang bzhi pa'i dam tshig ste bzhi yod/ rten gyis dbye na/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gsum yod de/ saṃ pu ṭa las/ bud med dang ni skyes pa'i lus// las ni du mas bskyed pa ston// mi shes pas kyang mi bya ste// sku yi rdo rje'i dam tshig go /phrag dog nyid kyis ma rangs pas// tshig rtsub la sogs smra mi bya// rna ba bde bar byed pa nyid// gsung gi rdo rje'i dam tshig go /sems can sna tshogs gdung ba dang*// kun rtog drwa ba'i rnam rtog gis// sems la smad par mi bya ste// thugs kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig go /zhes gsungs so// ngo bos dbye na bzhi las/ dang po bsrung ba'i dam tshig ni/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi dang*/ yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad de nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// gnyis pa bza' ba'i dam tshig la/ rgyun gyi dam tshig bdud rtsi ril bu dang*/ khyad par gyi dam tshig tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i tshul/ 'og le'u bdun par 'chad/ gsum pa ji ltar bsrungs pa'i dam tshig ni/ rdo rje dril bu dang*/ bgrang phreng la sogs pa rnams yin/ bzhi pa bsgrub pa'i dam tshig ni/ rim pa gnyis la rnal 'byor du byed pa nyid yin/ gsum pa ji ltar bsrung ba'i tshul la gnyis/ mi nyams par bsrung ba dang*/ nyams na bcos pa'i thabs gnyis yin no// de la mi 'byung ba'i thabs ni/ bla ma dang*/ rdo rje spun dang 'grogs pa dang*/ dran pa dang*/ bag yod pa dang ldan pa dang*/ phan yon dang*/ nyes dmigs rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba nyid yin no// gnyis pa nyams na bcos pa'i thabs ni/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung na slar yang dbang len dgos la/ yan lag gi ltung ba la sogs pa byung na bshags pa la sogs pas 'chos so// bzhi pa ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ dam tshig ma bsrungs na lam gzhan la 'bad pa byas kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung bar mnar med pa'i dmyal bar ltung ngo*// lnga pa bsrungs pa'i phan yon ni/

lam gzhan la 'bad pa ma byas kyang*/ dam tshig bsrungs pa kho nas skye ba bcu drug gi khongs su 'tshang rgya ba'o// de'ang*/ gal te ltung ba med gyur na// skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub// ces gsungs so// le'u bzhi pa'i/ rtsa ni gnyis gnyis rnal 'byor ma// re re'i rnam pa rnams su bshad// ces pa'i skabs su/ byang chub kyi sems 'pho ba'i tshul bstan pa la/ gang sbyang ba'i dngos po/ gang gis sbyong ba'i lha/ ji ltar sbyang ba'i tshul gsum du yod pa las/ de la thog mar gang sbyong na bdun las/ tshes ni yar gyi bco lnga/ mtshan mo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i cha dang bcu drug mar ngo'i tshes bco lnga/ mtshan mo stong pa'i cha dang bcu drug go /'pho ba ni/ lug glang*/ 'khrig pa/ karka ṭa/ seng ge bu mo/ srang*/ sdig pa/ gzhu/ chu srin/ bum pa/ nya/ nyi ma gzas 'dzin/ zla ba gzas 'dzin/ thig le 'gog pa/ nam mkha' 'gog pa ste bcu drug rtsa ni/ ro rkyang kun 'dar gsum gcig tu bsdus/ gzhan gnyis gnyis re rer bsdus/ bdud 'dral ma dang bcu drug yi ge ni ā li bcu drug byang chub kyi sems ni g.yas g.yon na thig le bco lnga bco lnga/ dbus kyi dang bcu drug dga' ba ni dga' ba'i dga' ba la sogs pa'i dbye bas bcu drug de dag gang na yod pa'i gnas ni/ lus kyi g.yas g.yon gyi mthe bo/ byin pa/ brla/ gsang gnas kyi cha/ lte ba'i cha/ snying ga nu ma/ lkog ma/ lag mthil/ mchu/ mkhur tshos/ mig rna ba/ klad pa'i cha/ spyi bo'i cha/ spyi gtsug dang bcu drug yod do// gnyis pa gang gis sbyong bar byed pa'i lha ni/ lha mo bco lnga/ he ru ka dang bcu drug go /de'ang bdag med rnal 'byor ldan pa'am// yang na he ru ka dpal brtson// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa sbyong tshul la/ gzhan gyi 'dod pa dgag pa dang*/ rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa gnyis yod pa las/ dang po gzhan gyi 'dod pa dgag pa ni/ slob dpon shān+ti bas/ sbyang gzhi rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis kho na yin la thog ma'i bdag med mas rtsa gsum sbyong ba bzhin du/

tha ma'i mkha' spyod mas kyang bdud 'dral ma dang bcas pa'i rtsa gsum sbyong bas sbyong byed kyi lha'ang lha mo bco lnga kho na yin no zhes gsung*/ 'di mi 'thad pas dgag pa la gnyis las/ gzhung dang 'gal ba ni/ 'bad pas kun gyi lhag ma spang*// zhes 'byung bas/ kun gyi tshig dang 'gal te/ rtsa'i mngon par rtogs pas/ bdud 'dral ma stong pa nyid kyi rtsa bshad/ mkha' spyod ma stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du gsungs pas stong pas stong pa la sbyong bar mi nus shing*/ gal te nus na/ zung 'jug gi lam mi srid par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa rang lugs la gnyis las/ sbyong ba'i tshul spyir bstan pa ni/ don gyi bya ba dang bcas pas/ spros pa'i rang bzhin gyi sbyang gzhi bco lnga po rnams spros med stong pa'i ngo bo lha mo bco lngas sbyong zhing*/ don gyi bya ba mi byed pa bcu drug pa'i cha rnams thabs kyi rang bzhin/ he ru kas sbyangs pas/ lus la sems dang*/ sems la lus kyi rgya ltar sbyang gzhi dang*/ sbyong byed du yang rigs shing*/ zung du 'jug par yang 'gyur ba yin no// gnyis pa 'pho tshul bye brag tu bshad pa la/ gang nas 'pho ba'i yul/ ji ltar 'pho ba'i tshul/ de ltar 'pho ba'i 'thad pa dang gsum yin/ de ltar thog mar gang nas 'pho ba'i yul ni/ lus kyi g.yas g.yon gyi mthe bong gtum mo nas spyi gtsug gi bar sngar smos pa rnams nyid yin no// gnyis pa ji ltar 'pho ba'i tshul la drug las/ dang po nam 'pho ba'i dus ni/ yar gyi ngo'i tshes gcig la/ skyes pa'i rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong gtum mo nas mgo 'dzin la/ bud med kyi g.yon pa'i mthe bong mi phyed ma nas mgo 'dzin zhing*/ mar ngo'i tshes gcig la skyes pa'i g.yon mi phyed ma dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas gtum mo nas mgo 'dzin no// de nas tshes re re zhing gnas rnams nas 'phos nas yar ngo dang mar ngo'i bco lnga'i mtshan mo spyi gtsug nas kun 'dar mar 'jug go

/de nyid ye shes thig le las/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi yan lag tu// yar ngo de bzhin mar ngo yi// 'dod pa yis ni 'jug pa'i tshe// bcu dang lnga ni gnyis med sbyor// zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa ngo bo gang 'pho ba/ lus kyi gnas de rnams na srog gi gnad 'dzin pa'i khams dwangs ma re gnas la/ tshes gcig lta bu la mthe bo'i nus pa 'phel zhing tshes gnyis pa'i mgo 'dzin pa'i tshe mthe bo'i nus pa de nyid du thim nas byin pa'i nus pa 'phel bar 'gyur ro// de ltar rang gi nus pa 'byung ba la 'pho bar btags kyi/ gcig nas gcig tu 'pho ba ni ma yin no// 'di la sman dpyad kyi gzhung las brla gnas sam gnad kyi gnad ces zer ro// gsum pa rnam pa ni/ tshes gcig dang bcu drug nas/ gnam stong dang*/ bco lnga'i bar a nas aṃ gi bar gyi rnam pas 'phos nas bco lnga'i mtshan mo dang*/ gnam stong gi mtshan mo kun 'dar mar aḥtsheg drag can gnyis kyi rnam par 'jug cing*/ a gnyis 'dres pas ha dang*/ tsheg drag gcig zhabs kyu dang*/ gcig klad kor dang thig ler 'gyur bas hūm̐ 'grub ste/ de ni he ru ka'i sa bon no// bzhi pa dga' ba'i ngo bo ni/ rim pa bzhin dga' ba'i dga' ba la sogs pa ste/ bcu drug pa ni lhan skyes kyi lhan skyes so// lnga pa lha mo gang gis dbang byas pa ni/ mthe bong tshes gcig la mkha' spyod ma/ byin par sa spyod ma nas rim pa bzhin te/ ro rkyang gnyis bdag med ma'o// drug pa ming ni/ lug la sogs pa bcu drug po rnams so// gsum pa de ltar 'pho ba'i 'thad pa la gsum las/ phyi rol du ji ltar gnas pa ni/ nam mkha' la rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor khyim bcu gnyis kyis bgos pa la/ nyi ma dang zla ba lho bgrod byang bgrod kyi tshul gyis rgyu ba dang*/ sgra gcan 'gros gcig gi tshul gyis rgyu ba dang*/ sa la ri rab dang*/ rgya mtsho dang*/ gling bzhi la sogs pa dang*/

dbyar dgun ston dpyid dang zla ba bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i dus su gnas/ gnyis pa de nyid nang du sbyar na nang gi g.yas g.yon rnams su thig le phra mo dpag tu med pa gnas pa la ro rkyang gnyis kyi nus pa sngar bstan pa'i tshul gyis byang chub kyi sems 'pho ba dang*/ nyi zla'i ngo bo ro rkyang gnyis kyi nus pas 'dren pa dang*/ sgal tshigs ri rab dang*/ lto ba rgya mtsho dang*/ yan lag bzhi gling bzhi dang*/ thun tshod bzhi nam zla dus bzhi dang*/ 'pho ba bcu gnyis zla ba bcu gnyis la sogs pa nang du gnas pa yin/ gsum pa des na chos thams cad sems su bsdu ba ni/ thog ma med pa'i bag chags sems la gnas pa lus la rtsa yig dang rlung sems la sogs pa'i rnam par grub/ de nyid phyi rol gyi don gyi rnam par snang ba yin te/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ bag chags kyis ni dkrugs pa'i sems// don du snang ba rab tu 'byung*// don yod ma yin sems nyid de// phyi rol don mthong log pa yin// zhes gsungs pas phyi nang gi chos thams cad ro gcig par shes nas bsgoms pas 'bras bu myur du 'grub pa yin no// le'u bzhi pa'i/ kye bcom ldan 'das thabs gang gis byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa lags/ zhes pa'i skabs su mngon par rtogs pa gang dang 'brel na/ bskyed pa'i rim pa lha ye shes su rtogs par byed pa'i thabs rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang 'brel/ de la gang zag gnas/ dus/ bsam pa/ bsgom bya'i rnal 'byor dang lnga yod pa las/ dang po gang zag ni/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i man ngag bla ma las thob cing*/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i dmigs pa la sems cung zad brtan par gyur bas bsgom pa yin/ gnyis pa gnas gang du bsgom na/ las dang po pas rnam g.yeng chung zhing yid spro ba'i gnas dang*/ sems brtan pa thob pas brtson 'grus 'phel ba'i gnas/ brtan pa cher thob pas rang gi rtogs pa cher 'phel zhing*/

gzhan don 'phel ba'i gnas su bsgom/ gsum pa nam bsgom pa'i dus ni/ las dang po pas dus nges pa can dang*/ sems brtan pa thob pas ma nges pa dang*/ brtan pa cher thob pas rgyun mi 'chad par bsgom/ bzhi pa bsam pa ni/ zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes kyis sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par 'dod pa'i bsam pas bsgom/ lnga pa bsgom bya'i rnal 'byor la/ rdzogs pa nyid ngos gzung ba/ rdzogs pa gnyis kyi spyir 'gro/ nyams su blang ba'i tshul gsum yod pa las/ dang po rdzogs pa nyid ngos gzung ba la gnyis las/ dang po gzhan gyi 'dod pa dgag pa ni/ 'ga' zhig gis dngos po'i gnas lugs stong pa nyid la rdzogs rim du 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ de ni lta ba yid la byed pa stong nyid kyi rgya dbu ma'i bsgom yin pa'i phyir ro// la la swa bhā was stong par bsgom pa rdzogs rim du 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ bskyed rim gyi sngon 'gro snang ba mi dmigs pa'i stong pa tsam yin pa'i phyir ro// gzhan dag gis lha bsdu ba la 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ bskyed rim gyi mjug sdud yin pa'i phyir ro// la la lha snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom pa la rdzogs rim du 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ bskyed rim gyi lha la zhen pa 'gog pa'i lta ba tsam yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa rang gi lugs ni/ slob dpon bir+wa pa'i dgongs pas/ bsgom bya grub zin nam/ rdzogs zin gcig rim gyis bsgom pa la rdzogs rim du bzhed pas/ de'i mtshan nyid ni/ mchog gi dbang gsum thob pa'i gang zag gis/ nyams su blang bar bya ba/ rten dkyil 'khor bzhi dang*/ dngos po'i chos nyid rdzogs zin pa rnal 'byor du byas pas mchog gi go 'phang bsgrub pa'o// gnyis pa rdzogs pa gnyis kyi spyi 'gro la/ lam la som nyi spang ba'i phyir phyi rol gyi spros pa nang du gcad pa/ lus nyid gtan la phab pas byang chub sems kyi ngo bo bstan pa/

byang chub kyi sems de mi spang zhing bskyed par bstan pa de gsum mo// dang po phyi rol gyi spros pa nang du gcad pa la/ sdom pa'i rab tu dbye bas chos thams cad rang gi lus la bsdu ba dang*/ rtsa dang byang chub kyi sems brtan pas sa dang lam thams cad nang du gtan la dbab pa gnyis yod pa las/ dang po sdom pa'i rab tu dbye ba la lnga las dang po gnas gang du bsdam pa'i gnas ni rang gi lus te/ rnal 'byor ma lus dbus gnas su// ā li rnam pa bsdam pa'i gnas// zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa gang bsdam na/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa mtha' dag bsdam ste/ saṃ pu ṭa las/ rnam rtog gti mug chen po pa// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin sgrib pa med par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa ji snyed gcig bsdam na/ phyi rol gyi 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bsdam ste/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*// sdom pa'i de nyid rab tu dbye// zhes gsungs so// bzhi pa thabs gang gis sdom na/ rang byin brlab dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i thabs kyis bsdam ste/ brtag gnyis las/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i thabs dang ni// zhes pa nas/ byang chub sems ni rab tu bskyed// ces gsungs so// lnga pa sdom pa rang gi ngo bo ni/ bde ba'i mchog tu gyur pas chos thams cad sdom zhing*/ rnam par rtog pa 'gog par byed pa gcig yin te/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ saṃ zhes bya ba bde bar bshad// sangs rgyas kun gyi bde ba'i mchog /sgyu ma thams cad mnyam sbyor bas// mchog tu bde ba bde mchog go /zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa rtsa dang byang chub kyi sems brtan pas lam thams cad nang du gtan la dbab pa la/ gzhi phung po khams dang skye mched/ sgrub byed kyi lam/ bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po gzhi ni phung po lnga/ 'byung ba lnga/ phyi'i yul drug

nang gi skye mched drug tshigs chen brgyad/ spyi bo rkang mthil gnyis/ nyon mongs pa lnga ste sum cu so bdun te rgyu'o// gnyis pa lam la gnyis las/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang thun mong pa'i lam ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ dbang po lnga/ stobs lnga/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad de/ sum cu so bdun no// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags kyi lam la gnyis las bskyed pa'i rim pa dang sbyar na/ thams cad gsang ba las/ dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi po ni// kha khyer zhes ni brjod pa yin// zhes gsungs pas/ gzhal yas khang pa byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun mtshon la/ des sbyang gzhi sbyong bar byed pa yin/ gnyis pa lha la gzhag pa ni/ rigs lnga yum lnga/ mig gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa drug gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa drug khro bo bcu/ mngon byang lnga ste/ lha sum cu so bdun gyis sbyong bar byed/ gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis ka'i rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la sbyar na/ mi phyed ma la sogs pa sum cu so gnyis kyi steng du/ sbas pa'i rtsa lnga bsnan pas rtsa sum cu so bdun/ pu dzā la sogs pa yi ge nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i steng du hūm̐ ring po brgyad dang*/ bh+rūm̐ ām̐ dz+rīṃ kham̐ hūm̐ bsnan pas yi ge sum cu rtsa bdun dang*/ de dag gi nang na gnas pa'i khams rnams ni khams bdud rtsi sum cu so bdun/ de dag la dbang sgyur ba'i rlung ni/ snying po ye shes rlung sum cu so bdun te rten sum cu rtsa bdun no// gnyis pa brten pa ye shes ni rten de dag la brten nas skyes pa'i mtshon byed dang*/ mtshon bya lam gyi ye shes te/ sum cu rtsa bdun no// lam de dag mthar phyin pas/ bsgrub bya sangs rgyas kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun 'grub ste/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga/ tshad med bzhi/

rnam par grol ba'i ye shes/ mngon par shes pa drug zag pa med pa'i yul drug la mnga' mdzad pa/ stobs bcu ye shes lnga ste sum rtsa bdun no// tshul de nyid saṃ pu ṭa las/ de nyid yang dag bstan pa ni// dga' ba la sogs sa rnams te// dbang po la sogs rang bzhin gyis// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gnas// phung po la sogs khyad par gyi// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ni gnas// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi// sangs rgyas nyid ni mchog tu 'bab// byang sems sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis// gang tshe 'dir ni gang gyur pa// dbang po phung por 'byung ba yi// sangs rgyas de yi de ma thag /ces gsungs pas bstan pa yin no// gnyis pa lus nyid gtan la phab pas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo bstan pa ni/ gong du 'pho ba'i skabs su bshad zin/ gsum pa byang chub kyi sems mi spang zhing bskyed pa ni/ rang byin brlab dang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgoms pas/ dwangs par byas pa'i byang chub kyi sems de la brten nas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan rin po che skye ba'i phyir/ spangs na dngos grub mi 'grub ste/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū tis/ dngos grub kun gyi rten gyur pa// byang chub sems ni nyams gyur na// rnam shes phung po brgyal 'gyur zhing*// ma smad dngos grub ga la yod// ces gsungs/ de nyid kyi phyir spel zhing mngon du byas na dngos grub 'byung ste/ 'di nyid las/ rnal 'byor ma kun las byung ba// zhes pa nas/ nges mi spang zhes gsungs/ gsum pa nyams su blang ba'i tshul la/ nyams su blang ba'i rim pa dngos/ de las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ ma skyes pa skyed cing skyes pa bogs dbyung ba/ lam gyi bar chad bsal ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi drod rtags dang snga yod pa las/ dang po nyams su blang ba'i tshul la gnyis/ rang byin brlab dang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'o// rang byin brlab la'ang gnyis/

dmigs pa dang bcas pa dang*/ dmigs pa med pa'o// dmigs pa dang bcas pa la'ang*/ zab mo rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang*/ mi zab rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// zab mo la gnyis las/ so sor bsgom pa la/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor/ rtsa'i rnal 'byor/ yi ge'i rnal 'byor/ thig le'i rnal 'byor/ rlung gi rnal 'byor rkyang du bsgom pa ste lnga'o// gnyis pa tshogs par bsgom pa ni/ de rnams las gnyis nas lnga'i bar tshogs par bsgom pa ste/ de la yang 'khor lo la brten pa dang*/ ma brten pa'i dbye bas mang por 'gyur/ gnyis pa mi zab pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ thig le shin tu phra ba'i nang du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rdzogs par bsgoms nas/ de la sems zin pa dang*/ spro ba dang*/ bsdu ba'i sgo nas sbyangs na ting nge 'dzin mchog skye'o// 'di la zab mo bskyed pa'i rim pa zhes kyang bya/ de'ang rdo rje gur las/ mkha' 'gro'i sna yi mthar gnas pa// yungs kar tsam du rnam par bsgom// yungs kar la ni 'gro ba kun// khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba// de ltar sgom par byed pa yis// rang byin brlab pa grub par 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ don gnyis pa dmigs med bsgom pa ni/ rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la gnad du song bas bde stong la sogs pa'i ye shes skyes pa de'i ngang la 'jog pa'o// gang phyir mi bsgom pa la sogs pa'i don no// don gnyis pa dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa'i tshul lo// gang la brten nas skye ba'i rten/ ji ltar bsten pa'i thabs/ thabs las byung ba'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin dang gsum yod/ dang po rten la/ dngos kyi rig ma dang*/ ye shes kyi rig ma gnyis/ dngos kyi rig ma lnga las/ gnas skabs kyis gsum du dbye na/ dbang dus su lang tsho gtso che/ lam dus su rigs gtso che/ 'bras bu'i dus su yon tan gtso che ba dang gsum/ gnyis pa 'debs byed rigs bdag gis phye nas/ gar ma la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas yongs su bzung ba'i phyag rgya lnga/

gsum pa ngo bo'i rigs kyis dbye na/ gar ma la sogs pa lnga'i steng du/ rgyal rigs ma/ rje'u rigs ma/ dmangs mo gsum bsnan pas brgyad de/ saṃ pu ṭa las gsungs/ bzhi pa dbang gis dbye na/ ma dang sring mo la sogs pa brgyad do// lnga pa rtags sam mtshan nyid kyis dbye na/ ri dwags can/ dung can/ glang po can/ sna tshogs can/ pad+ma can dang lnga'o// gnyis pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya ni/ rang gi sems kyis sprul pa'i rig ma ste/ saṃ pu ṭa las/ bstan pa la smod pa'i 'jigs pa dang*/ skye bo gdug pa'i nang du gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas rang gi sems 'ba' zhig der bsams pas sems la lhag par mos pa mngon du bya'o zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa bsten pa'i thabs la gsum las/ sbyor ba 'du shes gsum ldan ni/ bdag dang phyag rgya lhar bskyed pa lha'i 'du shes/ mkha' dang gsang ba byin gyis brlab pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbab pa dang gzung ba'i thabs la mkhas pa ni/ snyoms 'jug gi dbang gi gnas su byang chub kyi sems phab pa rlung gi nus pas bzung nas/ mtshon byed kyi ye shes nyams su myong bar byed pa yin no// gsum pa rjes bzlog khyab kyis mi nyams par bya ba ni/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i rim pa spyi bo'i bar du bzlog nas/ rtsa dang lus thams cad la khyab par bya ste/ mtshon byed kyi ye shes nyams su myong bar byed pa yin no// gsum pa thabs las byung ba'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin la/ gzhan gyi 'dod pa dgag pa dang*/ rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa gnyis las/ dang po gzhan gyi 'dod pa dgag pa la gsum las/ gnas la log par rtog pa dgag pa ni/ gnas yum gyi mkhar byang chub kyi sems babs pa'i tshe/ ye shes skye bar 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ khams gsum las 'phos na rten nyams pa'i phyir ye shes mi skye/ gnyis pa dus la log par rtog pa dgag pa ni dus skad cig ma gsum pa la ye shes skyes nas/

bzhi pa thig le nyams pa'i dga' bral gyi dga' bar 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ 'khor lo bzhi dang*/ 'dod pa khams kyi 'dod chags kyi rim pa dang*/ gzugs khams kyi bsam gtan gyi rim pa dang*/ gzugs med pa'i skye mched bzhi'i rim pa la sogs pa thams cad 'khrugs par 'gyur ba dang*/ sna tshogs dang po'i dga' ba nyid nas lhan cig skyes dga' nyid ces gsungs pa dang 'gal lo// gsum pa ye shes kyi ngo bo la log par rtog pa dgag pa ni/ dbang dus na skyes pa'i ye shes de mthong lam gyi ye shes su 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ mthong spang gi sgrib pa ma spangs pa dang*/ ye shes de nyams par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de'ang*/ gang phyir 'byung ba che bde ba// de phyir bde ba de nyid min// zhes bya ba dang*/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū tis/ dbang po gnyis byung bde ba ni// de nyid yin zhes skyes ngan smra'i// de yi de nyid bde chen du// rgyal ba mchog gis ma gsungs so// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa la gsum las/ dang po gnas ni/ rigs bdag gi thabs kyi kha dang*/ shes rab kyi rtsa mdzes pa'i spyi bo phrad pa'i gnas su skye ste/ e'i cha byad bzang po nas/ rin chen za ma tog ces gsungs/ gsum pa dus ni/ skad cig ma bzhi pa mtshan nyid dang bral ba la skye ste/ bzhi pa lhan cig skyes par brjod// ces gsungs so// gsum pa ngo bo ni/ rlung sems dwangs ma la brten nas 'byung ba'i phyir/ nam mkha'i zla ba lta bar 'dod pa la chu'i zla ba ltar dpe'i ye shes yin te/ 'di ni byin rlabs rim pa'i phyir// kun mkhyen ye shes de lta bu// zhes gsungs/ don gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid la gnyis las/ ngo bo zung du 'jug pa ste/ de'ang rang byin brlab kyi ting nge 'dzin gsal stong zung du 'jug pa yin te/ de'ang rim pa lnga las/ dbang po rnam bcas kun rtog dang*// dngos po med par rtog pa dang*// rnal 'byor pa ni cig car spyod// de ni zung 'jug ces pa'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/

gnyis pa de thams cad la khyab par bsgom pa ni/ zung 'jug de chos kyi rang bzhin yin pas thams cad la khyab par bsgom ste/ brtan dang g.yo ba'i zhes pa nas/ rab bsgom bya zhes gsungs/ gsum pa ma skyes pa bskyed cing skyes pa bogs dbyung ba la gnyis las/ mnyam gzhag la shin tu brtson pas rgyun mi 'chad par bsgom pa ni/ dang po rtsol ba dang bcas pas rtag tu bsgoms pas/ rnal 'byor goms pa dang*/ rang gi ngang gis rgyun mi 'chad du 'byung ste/ bza' dang btung ba zhes pa nas/ 'grub par 'gyur zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa rjes kyi spyod pa yul drug la rgyas btab nas spyod pa ni/ spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ mthong ba dang*/ thos pa la sogs pa'i yul thams cad ting nge 'dzin de'i ngang du shes par byas nas longs spyod de/ gzugs sgra de bzhin zhes pa nas/ spyod par bya zhes gsungs/ bzhi pa lam gyi bar chad bsal ba la gnyis las/ 'byung ba'i bar chad bsal ba ni/ nang du 'byung bzhi'i rlung dbang du bsdus pas/ phyi'i 'byung ba'i gnod pas mi rdzi ba yin te/ sa dang chu dang zhes pa nas/ mi non ces/ zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa rtog pa'i gnod pas mi rdzi ba ni/ nang du gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa ye shes kyi dbang du gyur pas/ phyi rol du chags sdang gi rkyen gang byung yang*/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang du mi 'gyur ba yin te/ rang gzhan zhes pa nas/ nus pa min zhes gsungs/ lnga pa ting nge 'dzin gyi drod rtags ni/ 'byung ba lnga'i rlung rnams/ ye shes kyi rlung du 'dus pa'i rtags su/ du ba la sogs pa rtags lnga 'byung ste/ rdo rje gur las/ dang po sprin gyi rnam pa ste// gnyis pa du ba 'dra ba yin// gsum pa me khyer rnam pa ste// bzhi pa mar me nyer 'bar ba// lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ste// sprin med nam mkha' 'dra ba nyid// de ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu// zhes gsungs/ brtag pa phyi ma'i le'u bzhi par/ 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste// la sogs pa'i skabs su/

bden pa gnyis kyi don la/ dbye ba'i gzhi/ dbye ba'i don grangs nges pa/ ming gi don bzhi las/ dang po dbye ba'i gzhi/ spyir blo tsam zhig ste/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas/ rigs pa drug cu pa'i 'grel par/ bden pa gnyis su 'jog pa de ni 'jig rten pa'i blo la ltos nas 'jog go zhes bya/ gnyis pa dbye ba'i don la/ blo gang la ltos nas dbye ba/ ngo bo gang dbye ba/ gcig dang tha dad pa bsam pa gsum yod/ de la dang po blo gang la ltos nas dbye ba la lnga las/ dang po nyan thos kyi lugs ni/ so so skye bo'i blo kun rdzob/ 'phags pa gsum gyi mnyam gzhag don dam/ rjes thob kun rdzob/ mya ngan las 'das pa blo med cing rdzas su grub par 'dod/ sems tsam pa kun brtags dang*/ ma dag pa gzhan dbang*/ kun rdzob yin pas so so'i skye bo'i blo kun rdzob/ dag pa gzhan dbang don dam yin pas/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i mnyam gzhag don dam/ rjes thob kun rdzob/ yongs grub don dam 'ba' zhig yin pas/ sangs rgyas don dam 'ba' zhig go zhes zer thal 'gyur bas ni/ so so skye bo'i blo 'khrul pa kun rdzob/ 'phags pa gsum gyi mnyam gzhag snang ba med pas don dam 'ba' zhig go zer/ rang rgyud pas ni/ so so skye bo'i blo kun rdzob/ chos nyid shes pa rnam grangs kyi don dam/ 'phags pa gsum gyi mnyam gzhag don dam/ rjes thob kun rdzob/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes don dam/ dag pa 'jig rten pa dang rnam grangs kyi kun rdzob tu 'dod do// rang gi lugs ni/ so so skye bo'i blo kun rdzob/ don dam shes pa rnam grangs kyi don dam/ 'phags pa gsum gyi mnyam gzhag don dam/ rjes thob kun rdzob/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ngo bo/ bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa yin te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam dag /so so'i cha ni shes gyur nas// gang du yang dag 'dres gyur pa// zung du 'jug par de bshad do// zhes gsungs/

gnyis par ngo bo gang dbye na/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa gnyis te/ mdo las 'jig rten mkhyen pas gzhan la ma gsan par/ bden pa 'di gnyis kyi ni rnam dbye mdzad// gang zhig kun rdzob gzhan ni don dam ste// bden pa gsum pa nam yang ma bstan no// zhes gsungs/ 'di gtan la 'bebs par byed pa la bzhi las/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ ma dpyad pa'i blo ngor grub cing blo de'i ngor don byed par snang ba'o// don dam pa'i bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ rig pas dpyad pa'i blo ngor cir yang ma grub cing*/ blo gzhan gyis gnod pa med pa zhes bya ba yin/ gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i mtshan gzhi blo'i yul du byar rung ba dang*/ don dam pa'i bden pa'i mtshan gzhi blo'i yul las 'das pa'o// gsum pa mtshon bya kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang*/ don dam pa'i bden pa nyid yin/ kun rdzob la yang*/ log pa'i kun rdzob dang*/ yang dag pa'i kun rdzob gnyis su dbye ste/ bden gnyis las/ snang du 'dra yang don byed dag /nus pa'i phyir dang mi nus phyir// yang dag yang dag ma yin pa'i// kun rdzob kyi ni dbye ba byas// zhes gsungs/ yang kun rdzob la rnam grangs dang*/ rnam grangs ma yin pa dang*/ don dam pa'ang rnam grangs dang*/ rnam grangs ma yin pa gnyis su blo ngor dbyer rung ba yin no// bzhi pa mtshan gzhi la mtshan nyid nges par bya ba kun rdzob kyi mtshan gzhi blo'i yul du byar rung la/ mtshan nyid ma dpyad pa'i blo ngor grub pa/ rang rig gis 'grub la/ don dam gyis mtshan gzhi/ blo'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir mtshan nyid yod med du dpyad du med pa nyid las ma 'das pa yin/ don gsum pa gcig dang tha dad bsam pa ni/ yang dag par na/ khyad par gyi gzhi ngo bos ma grub pa'i phyir/ khyad par gyi chos gcig dang du ma mi 'grub ste/ dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa las/ kun rdzob khams dang don dam de bzhin nyid// gcig dang du ma bral ba'i mtshan nyid de// gcig dang tha dad nyid du rnam rtog pa// de dag tshul min lta la zhugs pa yin// zhes gsungs/

tha snyad tsam du ngo bo dbye ba med pa la/ blo tha dad la ltos nas tha dad du bzhag pa yin no// don gsum pa grangs nges pa ni/ yul la dpyad bzod mi bzod gnyis dang*/ blo la rmongs ma rmongs gnyis dang*/ gang zag la 'khor 'das gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir bden pa gnyis su grangs nges so// bzhi pa ming gi don ni/ kun rdzob la saṃ bṛt+ta zer la/ paṃ myaka yang dag pa/ bṛ las/ ā ba ra ṇa sgrib pa ste/ yang dag pa'i don la sgrib pas kun rdzob/ don dam pa la pa ra ma ar+tha zer/ pa ra ma dag pa/ ar+tha don te/ dam pa 'phags pa'i spyod yul du gyur pa yin no// le'u bzhi pa'i gtor ma'i skabs su/ gtor ma'i mngon rtogs la/ gang du gtang ba'i gnas/ nam gtang ba'i dus/ gang gtang ba'i yo byad/ ji ltar gtong ba'i cho ga de ltar btang ba'i dgos pa dang lnga yod/ dang po gnas ni/ rang gi khyim dang dur khrod la sogs par gtong*/ dus la gnyis las/ rgyun gyi dus ni/ mnyam gzhag gi rnal 'byor gyi thun 'jug go /khyer gyi dus ni/ yi dwags zla phyed bcu bzhi la sogs pa'i dus gtong*/ gsum pa yo byad bza' ba dang*/ btung ba ci 'byor pa/ med du mi rung ba sha dang*/ chang yin/ bzhi pa cho ga la bzhi las/ rdzas kyi ting nge 'dzin la/ bsang ba/ sbyang ba/ bskyed pa/ byin gyis brlab pa bzhi'o// gnyis pa mgron gyi ting nge 'dzin la/ bskyed pa/ dgug pa/ byin gyis brlab pa/ dbang bskur ba bzhi'o// gsum pa gtor ma dbul ba dngos la/ gtor ma gtang ba/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ phrin las gzhol ba dang bzhi'o// bzhi pa mjug gi cho ga la/ rdo rje'i glu dang*/ bkra shis kyis byin dbab pa/ dngos grub blangs nas smon lam gdab pa/ bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol ba/ bdag nyid bsrungs nas gtor ma dor ba'o// lnga pa btang ba'i dgos pa ni/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa las// sems can rnams kyi srog bsrung phyir// zhes pa thun mong gi dgos pa dang*/

gal te 'dir gtor ma la sogs pas bye brag ched du bya ba'i dngos grub 'grub pa yin no// le'u bdun pa'i skabs su/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bza' ba ni/ nyon cig lha mo bzhin bzangs ma// zhes pa'i skabs su/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mngon par rtogs pa dang 'brel bas/ de la gsum/ ming gi don dang*/ ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga dang*/ de ltar byas pa'i dgos pa'o// dang po ming don la lnga las/ gang zag gi sgo nas btags na/ skyes pa kho na 'dus na dpa' bo'i ston mo/ bud med kho na 'dus na dpa' mo'i ston mo/ gnyis ka 'dun na tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes bya/ gnyis pa dus kyi sgo nas btags na/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ rab gnas dang 'brel pa tsam la tsa ru'i bza' ba'am/ dga' ston zhes brjod do// gsum pa rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas btags na/ lha'i rnal 'byor mi 'dra ba sgom pa 'dus nas byed na/ mdza' ba 'dus pa'i ston mo dang*/ lha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i gang zag 'dus nas dkyil 'khor gcig bsgoms na/ mdun bskyed gtso bor mchod pa zhes bya/ bzhi pa dgos pa la btags na/ rims dang mu ge la sogs pa'i gnod pa bzlog pa'i don du lha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i gang zag 'dus nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i bkod pa ltar bkod de/ thams cad kyis dkyil 'khor gcig gi rnal 'byor bsgoms nas tshogs kyi yo byad kyis mchod de so so'i dam tshig la bskul ba la sangs rgyas kyi gar zhes bya/ lnga pa mchod pa'i yul la btags na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro mchod pa ni/ rigs ldan ma mchod pa zhes bya/ grong gi chos kyis ma gos pa'i bu mo lhar dmigs te mchod pa la/ gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa zhes bya/ gnyis pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/ gang zag gnas/ dus/ yo byad/ cho ga dngos dang lnga las/ de la dang po gang zag ni/ dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa cho ga'i rim pa shes pa gcig gam/

tshogs pas byed pa yin no// gnyis pa gnas ni las dang po pas/ rang gi khyim dang*/ sems brtan pa thob pas dur khrod dang*/ brtan pa cher thob pas yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs par byed/ gsum pa dus ni/ yi dwags zla phyed bcu bzhi dang*// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bde mchog las/ zla ba mar ngo'i bcu bzhi dang*// khyad par du ni brgyad pa dang*// mar gyi ngo yi bcu pa la// mchod pas mchod pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i dus rnams la byed pa yin no// bzhi pa yo byad ni/ dkyil 'khor dang gang zag la med du mi rung ba'i rdzas sha dang chang bsags nas byed do// lnga pa cho ga dngos la gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba la/ gnas khang brgyan par bya ba/ rdzas dang yo byad bsham pa/ slob dpon nang du bzhugs pa/ sgo ba dang brda dang brda'i lan byas te/ shes na nang du zhugs te rgan rim gyis gral la 'khod na lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab pa/ yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs te srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang drug yod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bsgoms nas/ mchod pa rgyas pas tshim pa/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi myangs pas tshim pa/ chos skyong dang 'byung po gtor mas tshim pa dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma kha zas kyis tshim pa/ skye mched kyi lha glu gar gyis tshim pa/ bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyis tshim pa dang drug go /gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la/ lhag ma'i gtor ma gtang ba/ rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis kyis byin dbab pa/ dngos grub blangs shing smon lam gdab pa/ yi ge brgya pas cho ga lhag chad kha bskang ba/ bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol ba/ bdag nyid bsrungs nas las kyi rjes bsdu ba dang drug yin/ gsum pa de ltar byas pa'i dgos pa la gnyis las/ mthar thug gi dgos pa ni/ tshogs rdzogs nas sangs rgyas bar 'gyur te/ rdo rje gur las/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya mtsho'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to zhes gsungs/

gnas skabs kyi dgos pa thun mong gi dngos grub ci dgos pa 'grub ste/ gang du zos pas 'dod don kun// sgrub pa can gyi dngos grub 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// le'u brgyad par/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i skabs su/ mngon par rtogs pa thabs rgyud las/ skal ba dman pa rim gyis 'jug pa dang 'brel/ de la thun mong gi theg pa la rim gyis bslab pa dang thun mong ma yin pa'i theg pa la rim gyis bslab pa gnyis yod/ dang po thun mong gi theg pa la bslab pa la/ spyod pa rim pa can la bslab pa dang*/ lta ba rim pa can la bslab pa gnyis yod/ dang po spyod pa rim pa can la bslab pa la'ang skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ dus tshigs kyi gso sbyong dang*/ bslab pa'i gnas bstan pa dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang bzhi yod/ de la thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba la bdun las/ dang po yul ni sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang dkon mchog gsum yin no// mdo las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni// skyabs kyi mchog tu gyur pa ste// skyabs de dag la brten nas su// 'jigs pa kun las grol 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa rgyu ni/ yul la dad pa dang rang nyid 'khor ba'i sdig bsngal gyis 'jigs nas/ de las skyob pa'i don du skyabs su 'gro/ gsum pa tshul ni/ sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam/ dge 'dun la grogs su 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis skyabs su 'gro/ bzhi pa bslab bya la gnyis las/ thun mong gi bslab bya/ skyes bu dam pa dang 'grogs pa dang*/ de las dam pa'i chos nyan pa/ nyan pa'i don tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba/ yid la byas pa dang mthun par bsgrub pa/ dngos gzhi bzhi dang*/ dbang po mi rgod par bya ba sems can la snying brtse ba/ dkon mchog mchod pa la brtson pa/ ci nus kyis sdom pa bsrung ba ste bzhi/ yan lag dang de ltar brgyad do// gnyis pa so so'i bslab bya/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo las/

gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs song ba// de ni yang dag dge bsnyen te// nam du'ang lha ni gzhan dag la// skyabs su 'gro ba ma yin no// dam pa'i chos la skyabs song bas// 'tshe zhing gnod pa'i sems dang bral// dge 'dun la yang skyabs song bas// mu stegs can la phyogs mi byed// ces gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas ma yin pa la ston par mi 'dzin/ chos ma yin pa la lam du mi 'dzin/ dge 'dun ma yin pa la grogs su mi 'dzin pa gsum yin/ lnga pa phan yon ni/ spyir sdig pa 'dag cing*/ khyad par du log par mos pa'i las kyi sgrib pa bsrabs pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i sgor tshud pa yin/ sdom pa thams cad kyi rtsa bar 'gyur ba/ bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis bsrung bar 'gyur ba/ mthar thug skyabs gnas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba ste lnga yin/ drug pa dbye na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i skyabs 'gro gnyis/ 'jig rten pa la blo 'jig rten pa dang*/ yul 'jig rten pa gnyis/ 'jig rten las 'das pa la theg pa thun mong pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ thun mong pa la nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lugs gnyis/ thun mong ma yin pa la/ phar phyin dang gsang sngags kyi lugs gnyis las drug tu 'byed pa yin no// bdun pa ming gi don ni/ 'jigs pa las skyob pas skyabs su 'gro ba ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ 'tshe ba dag ni thams cad dang*// 'jig tshogs theg pa dman pa dang*// thabs ma yin dang ngan song las// skyob phyir skyabs kyi dam par bshad// ces gsungs/ gnyis pa gso sbyong la bdun las/ dang po blang ba'i yul ni/ bye brag tu smra bas btsun pa dang*/ mdo sde pas gang yang rung ba dang*/ gnas brtan pa'i lugs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' las len/ gnyis pa len pa'i gang zag ni/ bye brag tu smra bas gling gsum du skyes pa'i skyes pa dang*/ bud med dang*/ mdo sde pa yan chad kyis len pa dang bsrung bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gang yang rung bas len/

gsum pa bsam pa ni/ ngan 'gro dang 'khor ba las grol ba dang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pas len/ bzhi pa cho ga ni/ bye brag tu smra ba nam bsrung ba'i nang mor btsun pa'i rjes su bzlas pa dang*/ mdo sde pas bsrung bar 'dod pa'i nyin par len par 'dod pa gang yang rung dus su bzlas pas len/ gsang sngags pa rang nyid kyis sems bskyed pa'i tshul gyis len/ lnga pa bslab bya ni/ bsrung ba nyin zhag phrugs gcig la rtsa ba bzhi/ yan lag bzhi dang brgyad bsrung ste/ mdzod las/ tshul khrims yan lag bag yod pa'i// yan lag brtul zhugs bag yod de// bzhi gcig gsum rim go rim bzhin// zhes gsungs/ drug pa phan yon ni/ byang chub kyi sems kyis ma zin yang*/ mtho ris kyi go 'phang thob pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems kyis zin na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba nyid do// bdun pa ming gi don ni dge ba'i bag chags gso ba dang*/ sdig pa'i bag chags sbyong bas na gso sbyong ste/ gso sbyong rang gis blang ba las/ gang phyir dge ba ma lus gso ba dang*// bsags pa'i sdig pa 'di ni sbyong byed pa// de phyir gso dang sbyong bar byed pas na// de bzhin gshegs pas gso sbyong zhes su gsungs// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa bslab pa'i gnas bstan pa la bdun las/ so sor thar pa'i bslab pa'i rang bzhin nges par bya ba la gnyis las/ mtshan nyid ni/ gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las ldog pa'o// gnyis pa dbye ba la gsum las/ ngo bos dbye na/ bsnyen gnas/ dge bsnyen/ dge tshul/ dge slong dang bzhi'o// gnyis pa gang zag gis dbye na/ dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis/ dge tshul pha ma gnyis/ bar slob ma/ dge slong pha ma gnyis/ bsnyen gnas gcig tu bsdus pa dang brgyad do// gsum pa thob tshul gyis dbye na/ yang dag par blangs pa/ bsam gtan gyis thob pa/ zag pa med pas thob pa ste gsum mo// gnyis pa gang gis len pa'i gang zag ni/

gling gsum du skyes pa'i skyes pa dang bud med cho ga'i spyod yul du gyur pas len/ gsum pa bsam pa ni/ rang gi don du gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gi bde ba don du gnyer bas len/ bzhi pa ma thob pa 'thob par byed pa'i thabs ni/ so so'i yul gang zag gam/ dge 'dun la brten nas sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes tshang ba'i sgo nas len/ lnga pa gtong ba'i rgyu/ bslab pa phul ba la sogs pas gtong ste/ mdzod las/ bslab pa phul dang shi 'phos dang*// rtsa ba chad dang mtshan 'das dang*// mtshan gnyis cig car byung ba las// so sor thar ba'i 'dul ba gtong*// zhes gsungs/ drug pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'i tshul la gnyis las/ dang po mi nyams par bsrung ba ni/ dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum dang*/ dge slong ma'i sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi par slob ma'i chos drug dang*/ dge tshul gyis dge slong la bcas pa'i las gnang ba'i chos bcu gsum po ma gtogs pa'i gzhan rnams dang*/ dge bsnyen la rang gis ji ltar blangs pa'i sdom pa ste/ bslab bya de rnams shes par byas nas yang yang brjod cing dran pa dang*/ bsrungs pa'i phan yon dang*/ ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas bsrung bar bya/ bdun pa bsrungs pa'i phan yon ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pas ma zin na yang*/ bde 'gro'i phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyur 'gro ste/ mdo las/ khrims kyis 'gro ba bzang por 'gro// zhes gsungs/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pas zin na/ thar pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur te/ sum brgya pa las/ nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims sdug bsngal spong*// 'jig tshogs lta ba gdon gyi rtsa ba 'joms// zhes gsungs/ 'o na bslab pa'i gnas bcu po gang yin snyam na/ lus kyi mi dge ba gsum dang*/ ngag gi mi dge ba bzhi dang*/ yid kyi mi dge ba gsum ste/ mi dge ba bcu spangs nas/ dge ba bcu la slob par thams cad 'dus pa'i phyir ro// zhes rje btsun gong ma rnams gsung*/

chos rje sa skya pa yab sras kyis ni/ dge bsnyen la/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la/ skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen srog gcod pa spong ba la sna gcig spyod pa'i dge bsnyen/ rtsa ba gsum srung ba la sna 'ga' spyod pa'i dge bsnyen/ rtsa ba bzhi bsrung ba la phal cher spyod pa'i dge bsnyen/ chang dang lnga spong ba la yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen/ rang gi khyim yang spong ba la tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen/ yan lag brgyad ji srid 'tsho'ibar du bsrung ba la gong ma'i dge bsnyen te/ dge bsnyen la bdun dang*/ dge tshul dang*/ bar slob ma dang*/ dge slong ste bcu tham par 'du'o// zhes gsungs pa yin no// bzhi pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa la bdun las/ dang po byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin nges par bya ba la gsum yod pa'i dang po mtshan nyid ni/ gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las ldog cing*/ phan pa nye bar bsgrub pa'i sems pa rgyun chags pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sgrub byed khyad par can no// gnyis pa dbye na/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems gnyis so// gsum pa so so'i rang bzhin nges par bya ba la/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la gnyis yod pa las/ smon pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa ni/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la smon pas de thob par dam 'cha'o// 'jug pa sems bskyed pa ni/ sangs rgyas de thob pa'i thabs la 'dun pas/ de bsgrub par dam bca' ba rtsom pa dang bcas pa ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ spro ba che dang rtsom pa che// don che ba dang 'byung ba che// byang chub sems dpa'i sems dpa' ste// don gnyis ldan pa'i sems 'byung ba// zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa don dam pa byang chub kyi sems ni/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa las grol ba/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes so// de la gnyis las/ cha mthun pa ni/ thos pa dang*/

bsam pa'i tshul gyis spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa/ so so'i skye bo'i gnas skabs na'ang yod/ bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis mngon sum du rtogs pas thob pa 'phags pa la 'byung ngo*// de nyid dam pa rnams kyi spyod yul du gyur pas/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhes btags so// de'ang mdo sde rgyan las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab mnyes bya// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags// chos la mi rtog ye shes ni// skye phyir de ni dam par 'dod// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa blang ba'i yul la rten mthun pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ rten mi mthun pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ste/ gnyis ka'am gang yang rung ba las blang bar bshad/ gsum pa gang gis len na/ sems tsam pas so sor thar pa'i rigs bdun gyi sdom pa'i rten dang ldan pas/ dbu ma pas snying rje dang len 'dod kyi dad pa dang 'dun pa dang ldan na 'gro ba rigs drug ka la skye bar bzhed pa yin no// bzhi pa bsam pa gang gis len na/ sems can thams cad kyi don bsgrub pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas len te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de yi rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod// rtag tu gzhan la phan par sems// chos la mos dang de bzhin de'i// ye shes tshol bar dmigs pa'o// zhes gsungs/ lnga pa cho ga la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed pa brtan cing 'phel ba'i don du mjug gi cho ga dang gsum gyis bsdus pa yin no// drug pa bslab par bya ba la/ mi nyams par bya ba'i don du rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang*/ nyes pa shes par bya ba dang*/ nyams na phyir bcos pa gnyis su 'du ba yin no// bdun pa phan yon ni/ gnas skabs kyi bde ba dang legs par 'byung ba dang mthar thug mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bas/ phan yon dpag tu med pa yod pa yin no// gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/

byang chub sems kyi phan yon gang*// gal te de la gzugs mchis na// nam mkha'i khams ni kun khyab nas// de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ de rnams kyi spyod pa rim pa can la bslab pa bstan zin to// //da lta ba rim pa can la bslab pa la/ bye brag tu smra ba/ mdo sde pa/ sems tsam pa/ dbu ma'i lta ba la bslab pa dang bzhi las/ de la dang po bye brag tu smra ba'i tshul la/ gzhi shes bya'i gnas/ zag pa dang bcas pa dang*/ zag pa med pa gsum yod/ dang po shes bya'i gnas ni gzhi lnga ste/ gzugs kyi gzhi/ sems kyi gzhi/ sems las byung ba'i gzhi/ ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyi gzhi/ 'dus ma byas pa'i gzhi'o// de la gzugs kyi gzhi ni/ gzugs kyi phung po ste/ sa chu me rlung bzhi rgyu'i gzugs bzhi dang*/ mig rna ba/ sna/ lce/ lus te/ dbang po lnga/ gzugs/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg bya ste yul lnga/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs dang bco lnga'o// sems kyi gzhi ni mig gi rnam par shes pa nas yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i bar/ rnam par shes pa tshogs drug go /sems las byung ba ni/ sems pa la sogs pa lnga bcu rtsa lnga yin no// ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed ni gzugs dang*/ sems dang sems las byung ba dang mi ldan yang*/ 'du byed kyi char gtogs pa thob pa dang*/ ma thob pa la sogs pa bcu bzhi yod par 'dod/ 'dus ma byas ni rgyu rkyen la rag ma las pas 'dus ma byas kyang rdzas su grub/ nam mkha' dang*/ so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa dang*/ so sor brtags pa ma yin pa'i 'gog pa ste/ gsum du 'dod pa yin no// bka' gdul bya'i ngor gsungs pas drang don yin la/ bstan bcos ni nges don du gsungs pa rnams dgra bcom pas phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pas de la gtsor byed do// gnyis pa zag pa dang bcas pa la gang du gang dag kun nas nyon mongs par 'gyur ba'i snod bcud kyi rnam gzhag der skye ba'i rgyu gang gis kun nas nyon mongs par 'gyur ba'i snod bcud kyi rnam gzhag las/

gang la skye bar 'gyur ba'i phra rgyas kyi rnam gzhag dang gsum yod/ gsum pa zag pa med pa la bden pa'i rab tu dbye ba/ de'i mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa/ gang zag gi rigs kyi rnam gzhag shes pa'i dbye ba ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba dang lnga yod/ de la dang po bden pa'i dbye ba la gnyis/ gnyis su dbye ba dang bzhir dbye ba'o// gzhig pa'am brtags na dbyer yod pa/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang*/ gzhig pa dang dbyer med pa don dam pa'i bden pa ste/ bden pa gnyis su 'byed pa yin/ de'ang mdzod las/ gang la bcom dang blo yis gzhal// bsal na de blo mi 'jug pa// bum chu bzhin du kun rdzob tu// yod de don dam yod gzhan no// zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa bzhir dbye ba ni/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung 'khor ba rgyu 'bras dang*/ 'gog pa dang lam mya ngan las 'das pa rgyu 'bras so// de las kyang dbye na/ sdug bsngal ba/ mi rtag pa/ stong pa/ bdag med pa/ kun 'byung ba/ rgyu rab tu skye ba/ rkyen gyi rnam pa/ 'gog pa/ zhi ba/ gya nom pa/ nges par 'byung ba/ byang chub rnam pa gsum du phyin par byed pas lam rig pa/ bsgrub pa/ nges par 'byin pa ste/ bcu drug tu yang dbye ba yin no// gnyis pa de'i mngon par rtogs pa/ rgyud la skye tshul ni/ dang po tshul khrims kyi spyod pa rnam par dag par bya/ de nas lung gi chos thos pas shes par bya/ de nas thos pa'i don bsam pas nges par bya/ de nas nges pa'i don bsgom pas mngon du bya ste/ mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas// bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor// thos sogs las byung blo rnams ni// ming dang gnyis ka don yul can// zhes gsungs/ de'i sgom pa'i rim pa la zhi gnas bsgrub pa dang*/ lhag mthong bskyed pa gnyis yod/ dang po zhi gnas bskyed pa ni/ spang bya nyon mongs pa shas che ba la 'dod chags shas che na mi sdug pa/ zhe sdang la byams pa/

gti mug la rten 'brel gyi rnam par dbye ba bsgoms pas zhi bar byed la/ rnam rtog mang ba la dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ rngub pa rjes su dran pas zhi bar byed de/ mdzod las/ de la 'jug pa mi sdug dang*// dbugs rngub dbyung ba dran pa yis// zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa lhag mthong bskyed pa'i phyir/ lam lnga bgrod pa ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhis tshogs kyi lam/ sbyor lam la yang dag par spong ba bzhis drod/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhis rtse mo/ dbang po lngas bzod pa/ stobs lngas 'jig rten chos mchog bgrod/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad kyis mthong lam/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyis sgom lam bgrod nas/ mthar phyin pa'i lam gyis 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor/ gsum pa gang zag gi rigs rnam par gzhag pa la/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas te gsum yin no// nyan thos la so so skye bo'i gnas skabs dang*/ 'phags pa'i gnas skabs gnyis/ so so'i skye bo la/ dad pas rjes su 'brang ba dang*/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba gnyis yin no// 'phags pa'i gnas skabs la/ rgyun du zhugs pa/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba/ phyir mi 'ong ba/ dgra bcom pa dang bzhi/ de re re la'ang zhugs pa dang*/ 'bras bu la gnas pa re re ste brgyad du 'gyur ro// dgra bcom pa la'ang yongs su nyams pa ba/ 'chi bar sems pa ba/ rjes su bsrung ba pa/ gnas las mi bskyod pa/ rtogs pa'i skal pa can/ mi g.yo ba'i chos can te drug go /rang sangs rgyas la tshogs na spyod pa dang*/ bse ru lta bu gnyis yod/ bzhi pa shes pa'i dbye ba la/ shes pa bcur dbye ba/ gang zag gang la ldan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bye brag tu bshad pa gsum yod pa'i dang po shes pa bcur dbye ba ni/ kun rdzob shes pa/ chos shes pa/ rjes su shes pa/ pha rol gyi sems shes pa/ sdug bsngal shes pa/ kun 'byung shes pa/ 'gog pa shes pa/ lam shes pa/ zad pa shes pa/ mi skye ba shes pa ste/

bcu'o// gnyis pa gang zag gang la ldan na/ so so'i skye bo la kun rdzob shes pa dang*/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa 'byung ba srid pas gnyis dang ldan la/ mthong lam skyes nas chos shes/ rjes shes/ sdug bsngal/ kun 'byung*/ 'gog pa/ lam shes pa ste/ brgyad dang ldan la/ dgra bcom pa mi g.yo ba'i chos can la ni zag pa zad pa dang*/ mi skye ba shes pa ste bcu ka dang ldan no// gsum pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bye brag tu bshad pa la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ thun mong ba la'ang gnyis te/ 'jig rten dang thun mong ba ni/ mngon par shes pa lnga/ tshad med pa bzhi/ bsam gtan bzhi/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi/ zad par bcu/ zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched la sogs pa'o// gnyis pa nyan thos dang thun mong ba la zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ smon gnas shes pa dang*/ so so yang dag par rig pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gsum la sogs pa shes pa rnams yin no// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa la gsum las/ ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad/ stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum/ thugs rje chen po'o// gnyis pa mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa'i cha bshad pa/ mdzod las/ sangs rgyas thams cad tshogs dang ni// chos skus 'gro ba'i don spyod pa// mnyam pa nyid dang sku tshe dang*// rigs dang sku bong tshad kyis min// zhes gsungs pas mnyam pa gsum dang mi mnyam pa gsum yod pa yin no// gsum pa phun sum tshogs pa la gnyis las/ rgyu phun sum tshogs pa ni/ bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// gnyis pa 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa la bzhi ste/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pas/ spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa/ shes bya ji lta ba dang*/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pas ye shes phun sum tshogs pa/ gdul bya rnams mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa la 'god pas mthu phun sum tshogs pa/

mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pas/ gzugs phun sum tshogs pa'o// lnga pa ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par la bzhi las/ dang po ming gi don ni/ sems rtse gcig pas na ting nge 'dzin/ yid mi g.yo bar 'dzin pas na bsam gtan/ dmigs pa la snyoms par 'jug pas na snyoms par 'jug pa zhes bya/ gnyis pa rdzas su dbye na/ bsam gtan bzhi dang skye mched bzhi ste brgyad/ gsum pa 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur tshul ni/ ting nge 'dzin de dag zag bcas kyi tshul gyis bsgoms na 'khor ba'i 'bras bur 'gyur la zag med lam gyi ye shes dang 'brel bar bsgoms na rnam par grol ba mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur ro// bzhi pa de la rigs can gsum grub pa'i tshul ni ting nge 'dzin de dag dang bcas pa'i zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi lam gyi gzhi byas nas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor la sbyangs pa dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi khyad par gyis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu'i khyad par 'byung ba yin no// de rnams kyis bye brag tu smra ba'i lta ba la bslab pa bstan zin to// gnyis pa mdo sde pa'i lta ba la bslab pa la bye brag tu smra ba'i log rtog dgag pa dang*/ mdo sde pa'i lugs brjod pa gnyis yod/ dang po log rtog dgag pa ni/ bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs kyi mdo bas bstan bcos tshad mar 'dzin pa mi 'thad de/ bstan bcos nyid kyang mdo la brten pa dang gsung ba po ston pa la'ang ma gus pa ste/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ bstan bcos dang 'gal ba ni bla'i mdo dang 'gal ba ni de lta ma yin no// zhes gsungs so// lta ba dngos kyi 'khrul pa dgag pa ni/ phyi rol pa'i don khas len pa'i dbang du byas nas/ gzugs dang*/ sems dang*/ sems las byung ba/ rdzas su grub pa bden mod kyi/ mi ldan pa'i 'du byed dang*/ 'dus ma byas rdzas su grub pa mi 'thad de/ gzugs dang sems dang sems las byung ba la gzhan pa'i rdzas mi dmigs shing*/

sgrub byed med pa'i phyir dang*/ 'dus ma byas la rgyu rkyen med pa'i phyir/ rang gi ngo bo med la/ ngo bo med pa la byed pa med cing*/ byed pa med pa la dngos po med la/ dngos po med pa la/ yod ces brjod kyang btags yod du 'gyur gyi/ rdzas yod du ga la 'gyur/ de'ang slob dpon chos grags kyis/ sgra don bsnyon pa med rnams kyis// yod med phyogs kyi bye brag gis// dngos po nyid ni dpyad bya ste// 'di la 'bras 'byung rag las phyir// don byed nus pa ma yin la// don gnyer btags pas ci zhig bya// ma ning gzugs bzang mi bzang zhes// 'dod ldan rnams kyis btags ci phan// zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa mdo sde pa rang gi lugs brjod pa la/ mdo'i rab tu dbye ba/ mdo'i tshig 'chad pa'i man ngag mdo'i don gtan la dbab pa'i tshul dang gsum yod/ dang po mdo'i rab tu dbye ba ni/ brjod byas phye na/ bslab pa gsum ston pa'i sde snod gsum yin te/ lhag pa'i tshul khrims ston pa 'dul ba/ lhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ston pa mdo sde/ lhag pa'i shes rab ston pa mngon pa rnams yin no// brjod tshul gyis phye na/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis te/ mdo'i sde/ dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'i sde/ lung du bstan pa'i sde/ tshigs su bcad pa'i sde/ ched du brjod pa'i sde/ gleng gzhi'i sde/ rtog pa brjod pa'i sde/ de lta bu byung ba'i sde/ skyes pa rabs kyi sde/ shin tu rgyas pa'i sde/ chos rmad du byung ba'i sde/ rnam par gtan la dbab pa'i sde/ de ltar bcu gnyis so// rang sangs rgyas la ni sde snod la sogs pa med de/ gnyis pa mdo bshad pa'i tshul ni/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ rnam bshad rigs pa las/ mdo don smra ba dag gis ni// dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang*// tshig don bcas dang mtshams sbyor bcas// brgal lan bcas pa bshad par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdo'i tshig spyi dang bye brag tshan pa re la'ang*/

dgos pa'i don gang yin pa/ de'i bsdus pa'i don/ tshig re re nas bshad pa'i tshig gi don/ snga phyi'i 'brel mtshams sbyor ba'i don/ de la gzhan gyis brgal ba la lan gdab pa ste/ lngas 'chad pa yin no// gsum pa mdo'i don gtan la dbab pa gnyis las/ ji snyed yod pa gtan la dbab pa ni/ phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched kyi rnam par gzhag pa gtan la dbab pa ste/ phal cher bye brag tu smra ba dang 'dra ba yin no// gnyis pa ji lta ba'i don gtan la dbab pa la/ bden pa bzhi dang*/ stong nyid bcu drug dang*/ de bzhin nyid gsum dang*/ bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi dang*/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum la sogs pas/ lam dang dngos po'i gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs pa rnams yin/ de dag gis bstan pa'i don mdor bsdu na/ bye brag tu smra ba'i shes bya'i gzhi lnga las/ gzugs dang sems dang*/ sems las byung ba ni phal cher 'dra la/ 'du byed ni snga ma gsum gyi gnas skabs kyi chos las gzhan ma yin zhing*/ 'dus ma byas ni ming du btags pa tsam las don du grub pa med pas/ shes bya'i gzhi gsum kho na yin/ 'on kyang rnam par shes pa'i don gyis gtod byed/ phyi rol gyi don du gnas kyang des gtad pa'i rnam par snang ba shes pa yin pas/ snang ba 'di mdo sde pas kyang sems su 'dod/ lam dang gang zag gi khyad par la/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas bye brag tu smra ba'i 'dod pa dang phal cher mthun la/ byang chub sems dpa' la sa bcu dang*/ sangs rgyas la sku gsum dang*/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la sogs pa/ theg pa chen po dang mthun par 'dod/ des na slob dpon kha cig gis theg pa chen po'i khongs su bsdus pa'ang yod pa yin no// de rnams kyis mdo sde pa'i lta ba gtan la dbab pa bstan zin to// //gsum pa sems tsam pa'i lta ba la bslab pa la/ theg pa chen po sangs rgyas kyi bkar bsgrub pa/ mdo sde pa'i log rtog dgag pa/

rang gi 'dod pa dang gsum las/ dang po theg pa chen po bkar bsgrub pa ni/ nyan thos pa dag na re/ theg pa chen po zhes bya ba 'di ni/ kauṇ+ḍi n+ya la sogs pa sangs rgyas/ sangs rgyas nas mya ngan las ma 'das kyi bar du drung du bsdad kyang*/ theg pa chen po zhes bya ba ma thos pas nyan thos kyi gzhung lugs dag la ma grags pas bka' ma yin la/ phyis klu sgrub la sogs pas sbyar ba yin no// zhes zer ro// de bkar bsgrub pa la slob dpon rnams kyis mi 'dra ba mang du gsungs kyang*/ mgon po byams pas mdo sde rgyan las/ sngar lung ma bstan lhag cig byung*// spyod yul ma yin grub pa dang*// yod dang med na yod med dang*// gnyen po dang ni sgra gzhan phyir// zhes gsungs pa'i don nyan thos kyi sde snod dag las/ theg pa chen po zhes bya ba'i chos ltar bcos pa 'byung zhes lung ma bstan pa dang*/ kauṇ+ḍi n+ya la sogs pa'i nyan thos kyi chos gsungs pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la theg pa chen po'i chos gsungs pas lhan cig byung la/ shākya thub pa ma yin pa gzhan gyi tshig dang don la skyon med cing zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi phung po 'di lta bu spyod yul ma yin zhing*/ gal te shes pa byung na shākya thub pa'i rnam pa ma yin yang*/ sangs rgyas yin pas sangs rgyas kyi bkar sgrub pa dang*/ nyan thos kyi theg pa las ni rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid dang*/ sems can thams cad yongs su smin par byed pa'i thabs te zab pa dang rgya che ba ma gsungs pas nyan thos las gzhan pa'i theg pa chen po gcig med na/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas med la/ sangs rgyas gcig yod na/ sgrub byed zab pa dang rgya che ba ston pa'i theg pa chen po gcig yod par grub la/ chos thams cad stong pa la sogs par gsungs pa ni/ spang bya'i gnyen por gyur pa'i sgra gzhan gyis ston pa'i phyir 'gal bar mi bsam mo// de dag gis ni theg pa chen po sangs rgyas kyi bkar 'grub bo// gnyis pa mdo sde pa'i log par rtog pa dgag pa ni/

mdo sde pas phyi rol gyi don lkog na mo bden par 'dod pa mi 'thad do// dngos po'i mtha' rdul phran yin la/ de cha med 'jig med bden dngos su grub pa yin zer ro// 'di ni mi 'thad de/ dbus kyi rdul phran gcig la/ phyogs drug nas rdul phran 'dus pa'i tshe/ dbus kyi rdul phran la cha yod med brtags pas/ cha med 'jig ste/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ nyi shu pa las/ drug gi cig car sbyar ba na// phra rab rdul cha drug tu 'gyur// drug po dag kyang go gcig na// gong bu'ang rdulaphran tsam du 'gyur// rdul phran sbyor ba med na ni// de dus yod pa de gang zhig /cha shas yod pa ma yin pas// de sbyor mi 'grub ma zer cig /ces gsungs pa ltar ro// 'o na phyi rol gyi don yod par gsungs pa ci yin snyam na/ nyi shu pa las/ gzugs sogs yod par bstan pa ni// des 'dus ba yi skye bo la// dgongs pa'i dbang gis gsungs pa ste// rdzus te skye ba'i sems can bzhin// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gsum pa rnal 'byor spyod pa rang gi tshul ni/ slob dpon thogs med kyis theg pa chen po bsdus pa las/ shes bya'i gnas dang mtshan nyid der 'jug dang*// de yi rgyu 'bras de rab dbye ba dang*// bslab pa gsum dang de 'bras spangs pa dang*// ye shes theg pa mchog gyur khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs pas/ de ston par byed pa la/ shes bya thams cad kun gzhi'i rnam par shes par bsdu ba/ de'i ngo bo gtan la dbab pa/ de la 'jug pa'i tshul/ byang chub sems dpa'i sgrub byed/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa de'i gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu byang chub pa'i sa bcur dbye ba/ lam mthar phyin par byed pa'i thabs lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ ye shes phun sum tshogs pa ste bcu'o// dang po shes bya thams cad kun gzhi'i rnam par shes par bsdu ba la bzhi las/

dang po kun gzhi yod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdus pa las/ len dang bzod dang gsal ba dang*// sa bon las ni las rnams dang*// lus kyis myong dang sems med pa'i// snyoms 'jug de bzhin 'chir mi rung*// zhes gsungs pas/ kun gzhi med na lus len pa mi srid pa dang*/ las kyi rnam par smin pa myong ba mi srid pa dang*/ sems med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las ldang ba mi srid pa dang*/ 'chi 'pho dang skye ba la sogs pa mi srid pa'i skyon yod pas/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa yod de/ chos mngon pa'i mdo las/ thog ma med pa dus kyi dbyings// chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te// de yod pas na 'gro kun dang*// mya ngan 'das pa'ang thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// 'o na nyan thos kyi theg par ma gsungs pa ci yin snyam na/ de skal ba dman pas yul ma yin pa'i phyir ma gsungs te/ dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i mdo las/ len pa'i rnam par shes pa zab cing phra// sa bon thams cad chu bo bzhin du 'bab// bdag tu rtog par gyur na mi rung zhes// 'di ni byis pa rnams la ngas ma bstan// zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa de'i mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi ngo bo rig cing ma bsgribs la lung du ma bstan pa 'khor 'das kyi gzhir gyur pa yin te/ sum cu pa las/ de la kun gzhi'i rnam shes ni// rnam smin sa bon thams cad pa// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa de ltar ldog pa'i dus ni/ dgra bcom pa thob nas phung po lhag med du mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe/ rkyen zad pas rgyun chad pa'i tshul gyis ldog ste/ sum cu pa las/ de ni rgyun 'bab chu bo bzhin// dgra bcom nyid na de ldog go /zhes gsungs/ sangs rgyas pa'i tshe gnas 'gyur gyi tshul gyis ldog ste/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes gang yin pa// de ni me long ye shes 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ bzhi pa dbang phyug la sogs pa dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/
