'o na kun gzhi de'ang 'khor 'das thams cad kyi gzhi byed pa gcig tu rgyun mi 'chad par yod par 'dug la/ mu stegs kyis btags pa'i dbang phyug dang gtso bo la sogs pa'ang*/ rtag pa gcig tu 'khor 'das kyi byed pa por 'dod pas/ de dang mi 'dra'am snyam na mi 'dra ste/ mu stegs kyis btags pa de bdag rtag pa dang rang dbang can du 'dod cing*/ kun gzhi ni/ skad cig gis 'jig pas mi rtag la/ las dang rkyen gyis yongs su sgyur bas na/ rang dbang can ma yin pas mi 'dra ba nyid do// gnyis pa de'i rang bzhin nges par bya ba la/ kun gzhi de nyid la ldog pas phye na gsum du 'gyur te/ kun brtags/ gzhan dbang*/ yongs grub bo// de la kun brtags kyi mtshan nyid ni don med kyang rnam rig nyid don du snang ba'o// dbye na ngo bo kun brtags dang*/ khyad par kun brtags so// de la'ang lnga/ ming la don du rtog pa/ don la ming tu rtog pa/ ming la ming du rtog pa/ don la don du rtog pa/ gnyis ka la gnyis kar rtog pa'o// kun brtags kyi mtshan nyid/ rtog bcas kyi yid kyi shes pas/ phyin ci log du ma brtags pas na kun brtags so// gzhan dbang gi mtshan nyid ni kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa las byung ba/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pa/ gzung 'dzin la sogs pa gzhan du rtog pa'o// dbye na ma dag pa gzhan dbang 'khor ba dang*/ dag pa gzhan dbang mya ngan las 'das pa'o// ming gi don ni/ rang gi bag chags kyi sa bon las skyes shing*/ skad cig gnyis par mi sdod pa snga ma'i gzhan dbang du 'gyur ba'o// yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ gzhan dbang de nyid las/ don gyi rnam pa gzhan med par grub pa'o// dbye na gnyis te 'gyur ba med pa'i yongs grub sems can gyi gnas skabs dang*/ phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub/ sangs rgyas kyi gnas skabs so// ming gi don ni/ rang gsal ba de nyid las gzhan med par yongs su grub pas na yongs grub bo// gsum pa rnam par rig pa la 'jug pa'i tshul la bzhi las/

dang po gang zag gang 'jug na/ theg pa chen po'i rigs can tshogs bsags shing smon lam btab pa gcig 'jug gnyis pa rgyu gang gis 'jug na gsum ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba stobs bskyed nas sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas bsgrub snyam pas/ 'bras bu la mi zhum pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad la 'jug snyam pas/ bsgrub pa la mi zhum pa dang*/ bdag gang la chags pa dang*/ zhen pa mi bya snyam du stobs la mi zhum pa ste mi zhum pa gsum dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas yid la byed pa spangs pa/ theg pa chen po la som nyi spangs ba/ chos la phyogs 'dzin med pa/ rnam par rtog pa mngon zhen spangs te/ spangs pa bzhi dang*/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong dang zung 'jug la gus pas 'jug pa yin no// gsum pa ji ltar 'jug na/ thos pas ming la 'jug bsam pas rnam rig gi don la 'jug bsgom pas rnam rig tu lta ba las kyang bzlog nas/ yongs grub rang bzhin la 'jug ste/ de'i tshe 'phags pa'i sar 'jug pa yin no// de'ang mdo sde rgyan las/ byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams ye shes kyi// mtha' yas pha rol son rnams legs bsags nas// chos la sems pa shin tu rnam nges phyir// don gyi rnam par brjod pa'i rgyu rkyen rtogs// de yis brjod pa tsam du don rig nas// der snang sems tsam la ni yang dag gnas// de dag chos dbyings gnyis kyi mtshan nyid dang*// bral ba mngon sum nyid du rtogs par 'gyur// sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas// de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs// blo dang ldan pas gnyis po med rig nas// de mi ldan pa'i chos kyi dbyings la gnas// blo dang ldan pa'i mi rtog ye shes stobs// rtag tu kun nas mnyam par song ba yis// de la brten pa'i nyes tshogs tshang tshing dag /dug sman chen pos dug bzhin sel bar byed// thub pas gsungs pa'i dam chos legs bzhag pa// rtsa ba chos kyi dbyings la blo gros bzhag

/dran rgyu rtog pa tsam rig bstan pa dag /myur du yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol 'gro// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no// bzhi pa gnas skabs gang du 'jug pa ni/ lam lnga'i rim pas 'jug ste/ tshogs lam dang sbyor lam du ming la 'jug mthong lam du don la 'jug bsgom lam du goms pa la 'jug mthar phyin pa'i lam du don mthar phyin pa la 'jug go /bzhi pa byang chub sems dpa'i sgrub byed pha rol du phyin pa'i spyod pa la gsum las/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug tu grangs nges pa ni/ dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bkren la brtse dang ma rungs pa la brtse// kun 'khrugs la brtse bag med pa la brtse// yul gyi gzhan dbang gyur la snying brtse dang*// log par mngon par zhen la snying brtse'o// zhes gsungs pas/ drug tu grangs nges la/ de'i gnyen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug tu grangs nges so// gnyis pa go rim nges pa ni/ snga ma snga ma la brten nas/ phyi ma phyi ma 'byung ba dang*/ snga ma dman la phyi ma mchog tu gyur pa dang*/ snga ma rags la phyi ma phra ba'i go rim gyis gnas te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ snga ma la brten phyi ma skye// dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang*// rags pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir// de dag go rim yang dag 'dod// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// gsum pa ming gi don ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang*// bsil ba thob dang khro bzod dang*// mchog sbyor ba dang yid 'dzin dang*// don dam shes pa'i phyir bshad do// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ lnga pa de'i gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcur dbye ba ni/ sbyin pas sa dang po rab tu dga' ba nas/ shes rab kyis sa drug pa mngon du gyur pa'i bar dang*/ thabs kyis bdun pa ring du song ba/ smon lam gyis brgyad pa mi g.yo ba/ stobs kyis dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros/ ye shes kyis bcu pa chos kyi sprin rnams 'grub ste/

mdo sde rgyan las/ 'di yi mthar thug sa yin te// so so rang gi de sbyor bas// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ drug pa lam mthar phyin par byed pa'i thabs/ lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la gsum las/ ngo bo ni spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs las ldog pa'i gnyen po sems pa rgyun chags pa can no// gnyis pa dbye na sdom pa dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa dang*/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum mo// gsum pa so so'i don ni/ sdig pa 'gog pa ni sdom pa ste/ mi dge ba bcu dang*/ nyon mongs pa gsum dang*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar ltung ba las ldog pa ste/ skyes bus lam bgrod pa la rkang pa ya ba dang 'dra'o// bdun pa lhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa la gsum las/ ngo bo ni dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig tu yid 'dzin pa'o// gnyis pa dbye na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ting nge 'dzin gnyis sam/ dmigs pa dang bcas pa dang dmigs pa med pa gnyis sam/ spong ba dang bsgrub pa'i ting nge 'dzin gnyis su 'gyur ba yin/ gsum pa so so'i rang bzhin ni/ gzugs khams bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ gzugs med skye mched bzhi la sogs pa 'jig rten pa dang*/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug la sogs pa 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ dmigs pa'i yul la sogs pa la sems gtad pa dmigs pa dang*/ bsrung bya dang sgom byed las grol ba la mnyam par 'jog pa dmigs pa med pa ste gnyis dang*/ 'dod chags gyi gnyen por mi sdug pa la sogs pa spong ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ mngon par shes pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul mngon du 'gro ba la sogs pa bsgrub pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams ni ting nge 'dzin te/ skyes bu lam bgrod pa la rkang pa ya ba dang 'dra'o// brgyad pa lhag par shes rab kyi bslab pa la gsum/ ngo bo ni/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i blo gti mug gi gnyen por 'gyur ro// gnyis pa dbye na/

kun rdzob shes pa dang*/ don dam pa shes pa gnyis/ gnyis pa so so'i rang bzhin phung po dang khams dang*/ skye mched dang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ji ltar shes pas kun rdzob shes pa dang*/ de dag gi rang bzhin dpyad na rang gi'ang ngo bor ma grub pas shes bya dang shes byed las rnam par grol ba don dam pa shes pa ste/ shes rab gnyis ni skyes bu lam bgrod pa la mig dang 'dra ba yin no// dgu pa 'bras bu'i spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa la gnyis/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa slar mi ldog par spangs pa ste/ de ni spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa'o// bcu pa ye shes phun sum tshogs pa la gnyis las/ rten sku gsum ni/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ sprul pa'i sku dang gsum yin no// gnyis pa rten pa yan lag la lnga las/ gnas gyur pa ni/ 'khor ba'i chos mtha' yas pa gnas gyur pas/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mtha' yas par gyur ba brnyes pa yin/ gnyis pa dkar po'i chos kyi gzhi yin pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug mthar phyin pas/ rang dang gzhan gyi yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ stobs sogs sangs rgyas chos rnams la// de ni rin chen 'byung gnas bzhin// dge ba'i lo tog rgyu mtshan phyir// sprin chen dang yang 'dra bar 'dod// ces gsungs/ gsum pa gnyis su med pa ni/ stong pa dang snying rje zung du chud pa dang*/ dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig pa brnyes pas na ro gcig pa yin/ bzhi pa rtag pa'i don ni/ rten chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos pa dang*/ thugs rje chen po rgyun mi 'chad pa dang*/ sems can mi zad pas mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad pas rtag pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de dag gi rten dgongs pa dang*// phrin las dag gis mnyam pa nyid// rang bzhin dang ni rgyun mi 'chad// rgyun gyis de dag rtag pa yin// zhes gsungs/

lnga pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas brnyes pas/ sangs rgyas las gzhan pa gang gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi cha dpag par mi nus na/ yongs su rdzogs pa lta ci smos/ de'ang slob dpon ma ti tsi tras/ ji ltar khyod ni nyid kyis mkhyen// ji ltar khyod ni khyod 'dras mkhyen// ji ltar khyod gzhan mi 'tshal ba// de 'dra khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de dag gis sems tsam pa'i tshul la ji ltar bslab pa bstan zin to// //bzhi pa dbu ma pa'i lta ba la ji ltar bslab pa'i tshul la gnyis las/ sems tsam pa'i log par rtog pa dgag pa dang*/ dbu ma pa rang gi lugs brjod pa'o// dang po sems tsam pa'i 'dod pa dgag pa ni/ sems tsam pas gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i dngos po 'di rnams kun brtags pa yin pas 'khrul pa la snang bas rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bu yin kyang*/ de dag gzhan dbang sems skad cig ma yin la/ de'i rang bzhin yongs su grub pa gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma dang bral zhing rang rig rang gsal cha med kyi dngos por bden la/ de nyid dbu ma yin te/ dbus mtha' las/ yod pa med pas yod pas na// 'di ni dbu ma'i lam yin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar 'dod do// 'di mi 'thad de/ rig pa cha med kyi dngos po ni/ rgyu rkyen la ltos sam ma ltos/ ma ltos na med pa'am/ rtag par 'gyur la/ 'dod na 'khor 'das kyi rten du yod pa dang*/ dgra bcom thob nas rgyun 'chad pa dang*/ sangs rgyas la gnas gyur par 'dod pa dang 'gal lo// rgyu rkyen yod na bden par ma grub par 'gyur te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ rgyu dang rkyen las byung ba yin// rang bzhin byas pa can du 'gyur// ngo bo nyid ni bcos min dang*// gzhan la gnod ltos med pa'i phyir// zhes gsungs/ bdag las skye ba dang*/ gzhan las skye ba dang*/ gnyis ka las skye ba dang*/

gnyis ka ma yin pa las skye ba brtags na/ skye ba mi 'grub la/ skye ba med pa la yod pa ga la rigs/ dbu ma rtsa ba las/ bdag las ma yin gzhan las min// gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min// dngos po gang dag gang na yang*// skye ba nam yang yod ma yin// zhes gsungs/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis/ ma dros pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang dag rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes// de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin// rkyen la rag las gang de stong pa nyid// gang gis stong nyid shes de bag yod yin// zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa dbu ma rang gi lugs la/ chos thams cad bden pa gnyis su bsdus nas ston te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa// bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten// 'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang*// dam pa'i don gyi bden pa'o// zhes gsungs/ de la don dam pa'i bden pa ni/ spros pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba/ blo'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir/ dbu ma pa phal cher 'dra la/ rtag pa dang chad pa dang 'jug pa'i gzhir gyur pa/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa la tshul mi 'dra ba lnga yod/ de la dang po bye brag tu smra ba dang tshul mtshungs pa ni/ kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag shes bya'i gzhi lnga bye brag tu smra bas ji ltar 'dod pa khas len la/ kun rdzob tu de ltar snang yang*/ rig pas brtags na/ de dag so so'i rang bzhin du bden par ma grub bo zhes smra'o// gnyis pa mdo sde spyod pa ba ni/ kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag shes bya'i gzhi gsum mdo sde pa dang 'dra bar 'dod la/ rig pas brtags na/ gzhi gsum po nyid kyang bden par ma grub bo zhes zer ro// gsum pa rnal 'byor spyod pa ba ni/ kun rdzob bag chags las byung ba'i phyir sems tsam pa dang 'dra la/ bag chags kyi gzhi rnam rig nyid kyang*/ rig pas dpyad na bden par ma grub bo zhes zer ro// bzhi pa sgyu ma pa ni/ kun rdzob kyi snang ba nyid sgyu ma'i rnam par snang ba ltar/

rnam pa sna tshogs su snang yang*/ sgyu mas bslad pa'i dbang shes la snang ba ltar/ ma rig pas bslad pa'i 'khrul shes la snang ngo zhes zer ro// lnga pa 'jig rten grags sde pa ni/ kun rdzob rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ji ltar snang ba dang*/ 'jig rten na ji ltar grags pa tsam du zad la/ rig pas rnam par brtag cing dpyad du med de/ dpyad pa'i gzhi ma grub bo zhes 'dod do// de ltar na shes bya thams cad bden gnyis zung 'jug tu gnas pas/ gzhi dbu ma/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can la slob pa lam dbu ma/ sku gnyis zung du chud pas 'khor 'das la mi gnas pa/ 'bras bu dbu ma ste/ rgyu/ lam/ 'bras bu'i chos thams cad mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i phyir dbu ma'o zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dbu ma'i lam la ji ltar slob pa'i tshul yin no// //gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i theg pa la rim gyis 'jug pa ni/ sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas// de rjes kye yi rdo rje brtsam// zhes pa'i don ston pa la/ sngags kyi rim pa la ni/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud// bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la// zhes gsungs pas/ bya ba dang spyod pa dang rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde bzhi la rim gyis slob bo// de la thog mar bya ba'i rgyud kyi dbang ni chu dang cod pan gyi dbang ngo*// grol bar byed pa lam la gnyis kyi thun mong gi dngos grub ni/ zhi ba la sogs pa cho ga zhib mo ston pa ni/ rig pa mchog dang don yod zhags pa la sogs pa la slob/ mchog sgrub pa ni ras bris dang*/ mchod rten la brten nas sngags dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang dka' thub kyi sgo nas lam bsgrub pa ste/ bsam gtan phyi ma dang legs par grub pa la sogs pa nas gsungs/ gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang ni/ chu/ cod pan/ rdo rje/

dril bu/ ming ste lnga'o// grol bar byed pa lam la gnyis las/ 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub ni/ bzlas brjod dang sbyin sreg la sogs pa la brten nas 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub 'grub pa ste/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rtog pa la sogs pa las gsungs/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa ni/ bdag bskyed dang*/ mdun bskyed dang gnyis ka la brten zhing bde ba dang rnal 'byor cha mnyam par spyad pas 'das pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa ste/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa la sogs pa nas gsungs/ gsum pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi dbang ni/ chu/ cod pan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ming*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang drug go /grol bar byed pa lam la gnyis las/ gang zag slob ma'i rigs can ni/ slob ma'i dbang tsam bskur nas lha re re'i rnal 'byor la bslabs pas de dang 'brel pa'i lam bsgrubs la/ slob dpon gyi rigs can la ni/ slob dpon gyi dbang yang bskur nas de'i dam tshig la slob tu bcug la/ de kho na nyid bcu dang*/ dngos grub kyi ye shes dang*/ phyag rgya'i ye shes mchog gi dngos grub ste/ 'di dag de nyid bsdus pa dang*/ rdo rje rtse mo la sogs pa nas gsungs so// bzhi pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa la/ dbang bum dbang la sogs pa bzhi/ lam bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis la slob pa ste/ de'ang thog mar gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi pha rgyud la slob/ de nas bde mchog la sogs pa rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud la slob/ de ltar sngags kyi rim pa kun shes pa dang*/ kye'i rdo rje'i snod du 'gyur bas de rjes kye'i rdo rje brtsam zhes gsungs/ de dag gi phan yon ni/ slob mas gus pas blangs nas ni// 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// ces gsungs/ le'u bcu par/ bud med dang ni skyes pa yi// gang gi srin lag rtsa ba la// zhes bya ba'i skabs su/

mngon par rtogs pa rgyu'i rgyud dang 'brel bas/ rgyu'i rgyud la gnyis yod pa'i dang po mtshan nyid chos gang zhig rkyen lam dang phrad na/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'byung du rung ba rgyun chags pa can no// gnyis pa de'i rang bzhin nges par bya ba ni/ slob dpon gar+bha ri pas rgyud la 'jug pa las/ rgyu rigs spang bya rkyen la ltos// gang zag rnam pa bzhir ni 'dod// ces gsungs pa'i don la/ rgyu la ltos pa/ rigs la ltos pa/ spang bya la ltos pa/ rkyen la ltos pa bzhi yod pa las/ dang po rgyu la ltos pa la bzhi las sems can rnams sangs rgyas kyi snying po can yin pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi rang bzhin gdod ma nas rnam par dag la/ dri ma glo bur ba yin pa'i phyir sbyang du rung bas/ kye'i rdo rje las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// de nyid bsal na sangs rgyas nyid// ces gsungs la/ sems kyi rang bzhin spros bral de nyid la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de bzhin nyid 'di thams cad la// khyad par med kyang dag gyur pas// de bzhin gshegs nyid de yi phyir// 'gro kun de yi snying po can// zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa rgyu gang gis gang du 'khor ba ni/ sems rig pa nyid thog ma med pa nas lhan cig skyes pa'i dri mas bsgribs pas/ yul ji lta ba bzhin mi shes pa ma rig pa yin la/ de'i dbang gis 'gro ba rigs drug tu 'khor te/ byis pa mi shes pas bsgribs pa nas/ 'khor bar 'gyur gyi bar gsungs/ gsum pa rkyen gang gis ji srid du 'khor ba ni/ gzugs la sogs pa'i yul rnams kyis chags sdang skye ba'i rkyen byas nas/ las 'dus byas lam dang ma phrad na mtha' med par 'khor te/ kye'i rdo rje las/ kye bcom ldan 'das rnam par ma dag pa gang lags pa nas/ yid kyi bde sogs thob pa yin nam bar gsungs shing rin po che'i phreng ba las kyang*/

ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa// de srid de la ngar 'dzin yod// nga ru 'dzin las yang las te// las las kyang ni skye ba byung*// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// bzhi pa sems sbyangs nas grol ba'i tshul ni/ sems kyi glo bur gyi dri ma sbyong ba'i rkyen lam rnams bsgoms pas dri ma thams cad dag nas dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig par gyur pa ni/ rnam par grol ba mthar thug pa ste/ rdo rje gur las/ nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med// ngan par brtags pa'i rnam rtog gis// rin chen sems ni dri can byas// sems dag pas ni dag par 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa rigs la ltos pa ni/ sems can rnams kyi sems kyi chos nyid la khyad par med kyang*/ chos can gyi khyad par gyis rigs so so dang 'brel pa 'byung*/ gang gi rigs su gyur pa'i lha bsgrubs na 'grub nye zhing*/ rigs kyi rtags ni/ kye'i rdo rje las/ bud med dang ni skyes pa'i nas/ de yi rigs su 'gyur ro'i bar gsungs/ gsum pa spang bya la ltos pa ni/ nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa' spang byar byed pa'i nyon mongs pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi lugs kyis grol ba'i rkyen du 'gyur la/ de'ang nyon mongs pa gang shas che bas/ de dang 'brel ba'i lha bsgrubs na 'grub par 'gyur te/ rdo rje gur las/ byang chub chags bral las skyes spangs// sems can gang zhig bde byed pa// chags pas byang chub rab bsgrub phyir// pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ gang dang gang gi 'jig rten nas// las grol te/ zhes gsungs/ bzhi pa rkyen la ltos pa ni/ nyan thos kyi lam la 'jug pa'i skal ba med par 'dod pas mtshams med lnga byed pa'ang*/ gsang sngags kyi thabs dang phrad na/ lam la mi sgrib par grol bar 'gyur te/ brtag gnyis las/ mtshams med lnga ni nas/ 'grub par 'gyur gyi bar gsungs/ rkyen dge bas zin na myur du grol bar 'gyur te/
dge ba bcu las nas/ nges 'grub 'gyur zhes gsungs so// rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
